paper.title: Towards Physics of Multimodal Pretraining: Knowledge Flow, Modality Synergy, Early Unification, and Recipes
paper.abstract: Vision offers a critical axis for advancing foundation models, driving a shift towards natively unified multimodal pretraining. Despite this momentum, the design space and the fundamental mechanisms of how modalities interact during unified training remain underexplored. We provide empirical clarity through a systematic exploration of multimodal pretraining. Our controlled experiments on both synthetic and large-scale real-world datasets yield four key insights into the physics of multimodal pre

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单一模型技巧，而是一个更基础的问题：在原生统一的多模态预训练里，语言、视觉理解、视觉生成三种能力到底如何相互影响，什么时候互相促进，什么时候彼此竞争，以及视觉应当在训练的哪个阶段、以什么方式进入模型。现有很多多模态系统是先有 LLM，再把视觉模块接上去，因而很难看清视觉是否真正参与了基础表征的形成。作者试图把这个问题从经验配方拉回到可控实验：用合成数据和真实数据分开研究，把“知识流向”“模态协同/冲突”“早期统一”“可扩展 recipe”拆开验证，最后再在 13.5B MoE、2T token 规模上做组合检验。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把 unified multimodal pretraining 从“工程拼装”推进到“训练动力学研究”，给出了几个可操作的判断：知识迁移是明显不对称的，视觉不能晚接入，joint training 比分阶段 curriculum 更可靠，参数共享方式会直接决定模态是互补还是互撞。第二，它把视觉理解和视觉生成放进同一个预训练框架里讨论，而不是只看图文理解，这对 AR+diffusion/flow matching 联合建模很关键。第三，它给出的 recipe 不是停留在小模型观察，而是做到了较大规模验证，因此对后续原生多模态基座的训练设计有直接参考价值，尤其是数据配比、共享/分离结构、以及训练时序这三件事。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者采用的是一个 decoder-only、Llama-3 风格的统一骨干，并使用 Transfusion 框架把文本的离散 next-token prediction 与图像生成的连续 flow matching 放进同一模型。默认控制实验的主干是 1.5B Llama-like backbone，但由于为 text/image token 设置了 modality-specific split FFN，总参数约 2.3B；大规模验证则使用 13.5B MoE，在 2T token 上训练。文本 tokenizer 使用 Llama-3 BPE，视觉侧支持多种 visual tokenizer，以避免结论只依赖某一种图像离散化方式。

技术贡献可以拆成四块。

第一块是 knowledge flow。作者先在真实数据上看语言、视觉理解、视觉生成之间的迁移，再在严格控制的合成环境里做因果剥离。这里的关键不是简单比较多任务训练是否涨点，而是看哪一种能力会给另一种能力提供可迁移表征，以及这种迁移是否对称。结论是明显不对称：语言对视觉理解、视觉生成的帮助方式不同；视觉生成与视觉理解之间也不是天然互利，而是依赖概念类型。作者用合成数据把概念级 transfer 拆出来，这一点比只在自然图文语料上做 ablation 更干净，因为后者很容易被数据共现和任务难度混淆。

第二块是 synergy vs. competition。作者把“模态是否互相帮助”追到数据复杂度和网络结构两个层面。数据层面，过于复杂的语言或视觉任务会让模态争夺容量；相反，适度简化的一侧可以给另一侧提供辅助监督，形成协同。结构层面，作者分析 Transformer 内部哪些部位更适合共享，哪些部位更适合隔离。结论是 shared attention 更有利于跨模态信息交换，因为注意力负责 token 间路由；而 separate FFN 更适合隔离模态特有变换，减少在参数空间里的直接冲突。这个设计判断很像把 attention 视作通信层，把 FFN 视作模态私有计算层。作者还验证这种现象在不同 visual tokenizer 下都成立，说明不是某个图像表示偶然带来的结果。

第三块是 early unification。作者系统改变视觉数据引入的时间点，以及模态训练的调度方式，比较从一开始 joint training、先文本后视觉、分阶段 curriculum 等方案。核心发现是视觉必须尽早进入，而且要与语言同时共训练。若先把语言模型训得很强，再做视觉接入，模型会出现作者称为 vision laziness 的现象：优化更倾向复用已有语言先验，而不是认真更新视觉相关子网络，导致视觉表征学习不足。这一点对当前很多“先训 LLM、再补视觉”的路线是直接挑战，因为它说明后接视觉不只是效率问题，而是会改变最优解的形态。

第四块是 recipes。作者把前面三类发现合并成可执行 recipe：采用不对称的数据混合比例，使用 shared attention + split FFN 一类的参数共享设计，并坚持早期统一、同步联合训练。然后在大规模 MoE 训练中做单变量对照，验证这些设计在更大参数和更长训练下仍然成立。这里的价值在于，它不是提出一个新模块，而是把多模态预训练里最容易拍脑袋决定的几件事，变成了有实验支撑的默认选择。
summary.experiments:
实验分成两层。第一层是受控机制实验。默认模型是 16 层、hidden size 2048、GQA 32/8、SwiGLU、RoPE、QK-norm、FlashAttention 的 Llama-3 风格 decoder-only 架构，主干 1.5B，带 split FFN 后总参数约 2.3B。作者在真实数据和合成数据上分别研究三类能力之间的 transfer，并通过改变任务复杂度、参数共享方式、视觉 tokenizer、视觉引入时机、训练调度等因素做系统 ablation。摘要和正文给出的核心结论包括：所有知识流都不是对称的；视觉理解与视觉生成的关系受概念类型影响；模态协同与竞争主要受数据复杂度控制；shared attention / separate FFN 是更稳的结构折中；late alignment 会导致 vision laziness。

第二层是规模化 recipe 验证。作者训练了 13.5B MoE 模型，在 2T token 上做 controlled single-variable comparisons，把数据配比、结构共享方式、训练时序三类结论逐一放大验证。虽然题面截取内容没有完整保留所有表格数字，但从引言和实验设置可以确认，这不是只在小模型上观察趋势，而是把 recipe 放到真实大规模预训练里检验其可扩展性。阅读时应重点找三类数字：一是不同 data mix 下语言理解、视觉理解、视觉生成三项指标的 trade-off 曲线；二是 shared attention 与 split FFN 的组合对各模态指标的影响幅度；三是 early joint training 相比 late introduction / staged curriculum 的性能差距，以及视觉分支梯度、激活或学习速度相关诊断，用来支撑 vision laziness 的机制解释。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题—机制—recipe”三步读。

第一遍先看 Introduction 和每节开头，抓住四个主结论，不要一开始陷进实现细节。这里最重要的是作者研究对象不是传统 VLM 对齐，而是 unified pretraining 中三种能力的共同训练。

第二遍精读 §3 和 §5。§3 的价值最高，因为 knowledge flow 是后面数据配比和任务设计的依据。要重点看真实数据实验与合成数据实验是如何分工的：真实数据给外部有效性，合成数据给因果可解释性。看图表时要留意 transfer 是否对称、是否依赖概念类别，而不是只看平均分。§5 则直接关系到训练 recipe，尤其要看作者如何定义和诊断 vision laziness，是否通过梯度、参数更新量、模块利用率或性能恢复曲线来证明“晚接视觉”不是单纯训练步数不够。

第三遍看 §4 和 §6。§4 里最值得深挖的是 shared attention / separate FFN 的解释框架，这对原生多模态架构设计很有启发，也可以和 MoE、modality-specific experts、cross-attention-only 方案做对照思考。§6 则看 recipe 在 13.5B MoE、2T token 上是否仍保持同样趋势，尤其关注单变量控制是否严格，以及不同设计之间是否存在交互项。

如果时间有限，优先看：1）四个主结论图；2）knowledge flow 的合成实验；3）early unification 的时序对比；4）大规模 recipe 表格。预计精读 1.5 到 2.5 小时，若要复现实验设计或迁移到自家训练栈，时间会更长。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a foundational question for native multimodal pretraining: how language, visual understanding, and visual generation interact when they are trained in one unified model from the start. The goal is not to add another multimodal component on top of an existing LLM, but to understand the training dynamics themselves: where knowledge transfers across modalities, when modalities help or hurt each other, and whether vision must be introduced early rather than attached later. The authors frame this as the “physics” of multimodal pretraining and try to isolate it with controlled synthetic setups plus large-scale real-data experiments.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is concrete. First, it turns several design choices that are often handled by intuition into empirical claims: transfer is asymmetric, modality interaction depends strongly on task complexity, early joint training matters, and parameter sharing should be selective rather than uniform. Second, it treats visual generation as a first-class pretraining objective alongside language modeling and visual understanding, which is directly relevant to unified AR + diffusion/flow-style modeling. Third, the paper does not stop at small-scale observations. It validates the resulting recipe on 13.5B MoE models trained on 2T tokens, so the conclusions are positioned as training guidance rather than toy findings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The model is a decoder-only Llama-3-style backbone trained under the Transfusion framework, where text uses discrete next-token prediction and image generation uses continuous flow matching inside one unified model. The default controlled setup uses a 1.5B Llama-like backbone, but with modality-specific split FFNs the total parameter count is about 2.3B. The large-scale validation uses a 13.5B MoE model trained on 2T tokens. Text uses the Llama-3 BPE tokenizer, and the study supports multiple visual tokenizers so that the conclusions are not tied to one image representation.

The technical contribution is organized into four parts.

1) Knowledge flow. The authors first measure transfer among language, visual understanding, and visual generation on real-world data, then move to synthetic controlled environments to remove confounders. The key point is not just whether multitask training helps, but which capability transfers to which other capability, and whether the transfer is symmetric. Their answer is no: transfer is strongly asymmetric, and the interaction between visual understanding and visual generation is concept-dependent rather than universally positive.

2) Synergy vs. competition. The paper traces modality interaction to both data complexity and network structure. On the data side, simplified tasks in one modality can help the other modality, while high complexity can create competition for capacity. On the architecture side, the authors analyze where sharing helps and where separation is safer. Shared attention appears to support cross-modal routing and communication, while separate FFNs reduce destructive interference by keeping modality-specific transformations private. This is a useful architectural decomposition: attention as the communication layer, FFN as the modality-specialized computation layer.

3) Early unification. The paper varies when vision is introduced and how modalities are scheduled during training. The main result is that vision should be present early and trained jointly with language, not added after a strong language prior has already formed. Late introduction leads to what the authors call “vision laziness”: the model leans on existing language priors and under-optimizes the vision-related components. This is an important challenge to the common retrofit paradigm.

4) Recipes. The final recipe combines asymmetric data mixing, selective parameter sharing such as shared attention plus split FFNs, and early simultaneous multimodal training. The paper then validates these choices with controlled single-variable comparisons at larger scale.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments operate at two levels. The first level is controlled mechanism analysis. The default model is a 16-layer decoder-only Transformer with hidden size 2048, GQA 32/8, SwiGLU, RoPE, QK-norm, and FlashAttention. The backbone is 1.5B, and the split-FFN multimodal version totals about 2.3B parameters. Using both real and synthetic data, the paper studies transfer among language, visual understanding, and visual generation, then runs systematic ablations over task complexity, parameter sharing, visual tokenizer choice, vision introduction timing, and training schedule. The main findings reported in the text are: transfer is not symmetric; visual understanding and generation interact differently depending on concept type; modality synergy versus competition is largely controlled by data complexity; shared attention plus separate FFNs is a strong structural compromise; and late alignment induces vision laziness.

The second level is large-scale recipe validation. The authors train 13.5B MoE models on 2T tokens and run controlled single-variable comparisons to test whether the earlier findings survive scale. The excerpt provided here does not include all result tables, so exact benchmark numbers are incomplete, but the paper clearly positions the large-scale section as a scaling check rather than a small-model anecdote. When reading the full paper, the most important numbers to extract are: the trade-off curves under different data mixtures; the gains or losses from different sharing patterns such as shared attention versus split FFNs; and the gap between early joint training and late or staged introduction of vision, ideally together with optimization diagnostics that support the vision-laziness interpretation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good reading order is problem, mechanism, then recipe.

Start with the introduction and section openings to lock in the four claims. The paper is not about standard VLM alignment; it is about unified multimodal pretraining where language, visual understanding, and visual generation are trained together.

Then read Section 3 and Section 5 carefully. Section 3 is the center of the paper because the knowledge-flow analysis motivates the later data-mixing recipe. Pay attention to how real-data experiments and synthetic experiments play different roles: one gives external realism, the other gives cleaner causal interpretation. Do not only look at average scores; check whether transfer is directional and concept-specific. Section 5 matters because it directly informs training strategy. Focus on how the paper defines and diagnoses vision laziness, and whether the evidence comes from gradients, parameter updates, module utilization, or recovery curves.

After that, read Section 4 and Section 6. In Section 4, the most useful takeaway is the shared-attention / separate-FFN design logic. It is worth comparing mentally against alternatives such as full sharing, cross-attention-only fusion, or modality-specific experts. In Section 6, check whether the large-scale MoE results preserve the same trends and whether the single-variable controls are actually clean.

If time is limited, prioritize: the four headline figures, the synthetic knowledge-flow experiments, the early-unification timing comparisons, and the large-scale recipe tables. A careful read should take around 1.5 to 2.5 hours.

recommendation.zh: 这类 paper 值得看不是因为分数，而是它把 unified multimodal pretrain 的几个脏变量拆干净了；先看知识流和 early unification 的 ablation，足够改你内部 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth reading not for headline numbers but because it isolates the messy variables in unified multimodal pretraining; start with the knowledge-flow and early-unification ablations—they can directly change your internal recipe.

paper.title: N_0-VTLA: Scaling Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Model with Latent Tactile Tokens
paper.abstract: We present N_0-VTLA, a vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) foundation model capable of (1) fine-grained contact-rich manipulation with tactile perception and tactile-feedback control, and (2) offline policy improvement from stored deployment data. Building on current vision-based backbones, we propose a training recipe for tactile integration consisting of visuo-tactile pre-training, staged tactile-pathway integration, and advantage-conditioned offline policy improvement. During pre-training,

summary.core_problem: 研究如何把触觉信号作为可训练模态接入 vision-language-action 模型，使机器人在接触密集的精细操作中利用触觉反馈。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态具身预训练和触觉 tokenization。它不是 LLM 基座预训练的核心论文，但“把新传感模态离散化或潜变量化后接入统一模型”的问题与多模态预训练有相通性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 N_0-VTLA，一个 vision-tactile-language-action foundation model。方法包括大规模 visuo-tactile pre-training、分阶段 tactile pathway integration，以及 advantage-conditioned offline policy improvement。触觉部分使用 latent tactile tokens，并通过预测式触觉通路把预训练中学到的接触模式迁移到下游精细动作控制。离线策略改进方法称为 ALTER。
summary.experiments: 摘要称模型在 NeoData 大规模视觉-触觉机器人数据上进行预训练，并面向 contact-rich manipulation 与存储部署数据上的 offline policy improvement。提供的摘要未给出参数量、NeoData 规模、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度，因此实验可信度需要看正文的 ablation 和数据覆盖。
summary.authors_note: 作者为 NeoteAI Team 和 Fudan TEAI Team。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to integrate tactile signals into vision-language-action models so that robots can use tactile feedback for fine-grained, contact-rich manipulation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in embodied multimodal pretraining and tactile tokenization. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to the broader question of how new sensory modalities can be represented and trained inside unified foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: N_0-VTLA is a vision-tactile-language-action foundation model using latent tactile tokens. The training recipe combines large-scale visuo-tactile pretraining, staged integration of a tactile pathway, and advantage-conditioned offline policy improvement. A predictive tactile pathway is used to distill contact patterns learned at scale into fine motion adjustments, and the offline improvement component is named ALTER.
summary_en.experiments: The model is pretrained on NeoData, described as a large-scale visuo-tactile robot dataset, and is evaluated for contact-rich manipulation and offline policy improvement from stored deployment data. The provided abstract does not report parameter counts, dataset size, baselines, or numerical gains, so the main evidence depends on the full ablations.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is by the NeoteAI Team and the Fudan TEAI Team.

recommendation.zh: 把 tactile 做 latent token 接到 VLA 值得登记；若正文没有干净 scaling 和 ablation，对 pretrain 只是模态 tokenization 备查。
recommendation.en: Worth logging for its latent tactile-token interface to VLA models; without clean scaling and ablations, it is mainly a modality-tokenization reference for pretraining work.

paper.title: dRAE: Representation Autoencoder with Hyper-Spherical Codes
paper.abstract: In this work, we aim to discretize the high-dimensional visual representations to bridge the gap with language models - a non-trivial challenge, as existing quantization methods suffer from codebook collapse, failing to scale while preserving semantic coherence. We identify the root cause as metric mismatch: standard Euclidean codebook objectives are fundamentally misaligned with the anisotropic geometry of representation space, leading to codebook embeddings with high-variance magnitude scales

summary.core_problem: 解决现有视觉表示离散化方法因欧氏码本目标与视觉表示空间各向异性几何不匹配导致的码本崩溃、码本扩展性差与语义一致性丢失问题，目标是生成适配语言模型的离散视觉token。
summary.importance: 方法创新，从几何匹配视角解释码本崩溃的根源，提出超球面量化范式，为视觉tokenizer设计提供新思路，可支撑多模态统一预训练的视觉端离散化。
summary.technical_approach: 提出超球面量化（HSQ），通过角度路由解耦视觉特征的语义内容与幅度，避免码本分配被特征尺度主导；基于HSQ构建离散表示自编码器dRAE，实现高保真重建同时保持语义完整性，支持可扩展的码本预算。
summary.experiments: 摘要信息有限，仅提及大量实验验证了dRAE在重建质量、语义保持与码本扩展性上的稳定提升，未披露具体模型规模、数据集、基线与量化提升幅度，也未涉及大规模多模态LLM预训练实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学院大学、浙江大学、北京大学，Qixiang Ye团队长期从事视觉表示学习与多模态相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses codebook collapse, poor scalability, and semantic consistency loss in existing visual representation discretization methods, caused by metric mismatch between Euclidean codebook objectives and the anisotropic geometry of visual representation spaces, aiming to generate discrete visual tokens compatible with language models.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation; explains codebook collapse from a geometric matching perspective and proposes a hyper-spherical quantization paradigm, providing new insights for visual tokenizer design in unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Hyper-Spherical Quantization (HSQ) that decouples semantic content from feature magnitude via angular routing, preventing code assignment from being dominated by feature scale; builds the discrete Representation Autoencoder (dRAE) based on HSQ for high-fidelity reconstruction with semantic integrity and scalable codebook budgets.
summary_en.experiments: Limited information from abstract; only mentions extensive experiments show consistent improvements in reconstruction quality, semantic preservation, and codebook scalability. No specific model size, dataset, baseline, or improvement metrics are disclosed, and no large-scale multimodal LLM pretraining experiments are included.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Zhejiang University, and Peking University. Qixiang Ye's team has long worked on visual representation learning and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 视觉tokenizer的新量化思路，从几何匹配角度解释码本崩溃，做多模态预训练的可扫一眼方法部分，纯文本预训练研究员无需关注。
recommendation.en: Novel quantization perspective for visual tokenizers from geometric matching; worth a quick skim of the method section for multimodal pretraining researchers, irrelevant for pure text LLM pretraining.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Monkey King Bang: A Unified Scientific Multimodal Foundation Model
paper.abstract: Scientific discovery is increasingly shifting from isolated disciplines to multi-domain reasoning, and AI for science faces a similar transition. Existing systems are either specialised for individual domains or unify scientific data mainly through text tokenisation and prompt-based interfaces, limiting their ability to handle diverse scientific inputs, produce modality-native outputs, and support joint understanding, reasoning, and generation across scientific domains. We introduce MKB, a unifi

summary.core_problem: 现有科学AI系统要么为单领域专用，要么仅通过文本token化统一科学数据，无法原生处理多科学模态输入、输出模态原生结果、支持跨模态联合理解与生成。
summary.importance: 构建了覆盖六类科学模态的统一多模态基础模型MKB，支持多类模态原生输出，采用两阶段训练课程实现跨模态对齐与联合建模。
summary.technical_approach: 采用共享Transformer主干网络，搭配模态定制的编码器、适配器、解码器；训练采用“先模态后语言”的两阶段课程：第一阶段对齐各模态编解码器，第二阶段开展语言与跨模态联合训练；覆盖DNA、RNA、蛋白质、小分子、地球科学、医学影像六个分支。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体定量实验结果，仅说明模型支持跨模态理解与生成、多类原生模态输出。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI for science systems are either domain-specific or unify scientific data only via text tokenization, limiting their ability to process diverse scientific inputs natively, produce modality-native outputs, and support joint cross-modal understanding and generation.
summary_en.importance: Introduces MKB, a unified scientific multimodal foundation model covering six scientific domains, supporting native modality outputs, with a two-stage training curriculum for cross-modal alignment and joint modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a shared Transformer backbone with modality-specific encoders, adapters, and decoders; trains with a two-stage modality-then-language curriculum: stage 1 aligns modality-specific encoders/decoders, stage 2 performs joint language and cross-modal training; covers DNA, RNA, proteins, small molecules, earth science, and medical images.
summary_en.experiments: No quantitative experimental results are disclosed in the abstract, only that the model supports cross-modal understanding/generation and multiple native modality outputs.

recommendation.zh: 科学领域多模态统一的工程性工作，无明确范式创新，作为跨模态统一文献备查即可，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Engineering effort for scientific multimodal unification with no clear paradigm novelty; keep as reference, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
paper.abstract: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 VLA 机器人模型的数据规模问题：真实机器人遥操作数据昂贵、任务窄、环境重复，难以像 LLM 和 VLM 一样通过大规模预训练获得泛化能力。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练研究的直接相关性有限，但对“跨模态行为模型如何做大规模预训练”有启发。它把非机器人 UMI 轨迹、自动语言标注、跨 embodiment 对齐组织成两阶段 recipe，类似于先学通用 action-generation prior，再用高质量机器人数据做 post-training alignment。这个思路和基座模型中的 pretrain-posttrain 接口相近，尤其值得关注其数据标注和 scaling 实验。
summary.technical_approach: 模型是端到端 vision-language-action policy，输入视觉观察和语言指令，输出 action chunk。训练分两阶段。预训练阶段使用超过 100k 小时真实世界 manipulation trajectories，主要来自 UMI 设备。由于人工切分和标注在这个规模下成本过高，作者使用预训练 VLM 自动给固定长度轨迹片段生成自然语言描述，描述的是场景状态变化，而不是传统的命令式任务标签。模型因此学习“从当前状态到语言指定目标状态”的动作生成能力。post-training 阶段使用超过 10k 小时 cross-embodiment 数据，把 UMI gripper 的动作 prior 对齐到真实机器人 embodiment，并把 state-transition prompt 对齐到人类常用的 imperative instruction。架构上采用 Mixture-of-Transformers，并以 Qwen3-VL 作为视觉语言 backbone 的一部分。
summary.experiments: 实验显示预训练阶段存在清晰 scaling 行为：数据和模型规模增加时，validation action error 下降。更重要的是，这种预训练阶段的优势会传递到 post-training 后的真实机器人成功率。少样本适配实验中，在四个复杂 dexterous tasks 上，每个任务平均少于 10 小时数据，Xiaomi-Robotics-1 平均成功率为 75%，对比 π0.5 的 40%。仿真评测覆盖 RoboCasa、RoboCasa365、VLABench 和 RoboDojo。RoboCasa365 成功率为 57.6%，高于此前 46.6%；RoboDojo 平均分 20.07，高于此前 13.07。论文还展示了超过 10 分钟的房间级长程 suitcase packing 任务。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看数据构造和训练 recipe，而不是机器人 benchmark 排名。优先阅读 introduction 中对数据瓶颈的定义、Xiaomi-Robotics-1 章节中的两阶段训练、自动标注流程，以及 scaling 实验。对预训练研究更有用的问题是：自动生成的 state-transition captions 是否足够稳定；UMI 数据学到的 action prior 如何迁移到机器人 embodiment；validation action error 和真实任务成功率之间相关性有多强。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the data-scaling bottleneck for vision-language-action robotics models: real-robot teleoperation is expensive, hardware-bound, and often narrow in task and environment diversity.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, but it is useful as a case study in large-scale multimodal action pretraining. The paper separates broad action-prior learning from embodiment and instruction alignment, which resembles the pretraining-to-posttraining interface used in foundation models. The most relevant parts are the trajectory auto-labeling pipeline, the use of state-transition language as supervision, and the scaling experiments showing that better pretraining transfers to better post-training performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is an end-to-end VLA policy that maps visual observations and language prompts to action chunks. Training has two stages. In pretraining, the model uses more than 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected with UMI devices. Since manual segmentation and annotation would not scale, the authors use a pretrained VLM to label fixed-length trajectory clips with natural-language descriptions of scene state transitions. This changes the supervision format from imperative task labels to descriptions of how the scene changes. The model learns to generate actions that move the scene from the current state toward the language-specified target state. In post-training, more than 10k hours of cross-embodiment robot data are used to align the UMI-derived action prior to robot embodiments and to convert state-transition prompting into human-style instructions. The model uses a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and incorporates Qwen3-VL as part of its vision-language backbone.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports scaling behavior during pretraining: larger models and more data reduce validation action error. This pretraining advantage transfers to post-training, where stronger pretrained models achieve higher real-robot success rates in unseen environments. In low-data adaptation, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 reaches an average success rate of 75% across four complex dexterous tasks with less than 10 hours of data per task on average, compared with 40% for π0.5. The model is also evaluated on RoboCasa, RoboCasa365, VLABench, and RoboDojo. It reports 57.6% success on RoboCasa365 compared with a previous 46.6%, and an average RoboDojo score of 20.07 compared with 13.07. The paper also demonstrates a long-horizon room-level suitcase-packing task lasting more than 10 minutes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the data pipeline and training recipe rather than the robotics leaderboard numbers. The most useful parts are the motivation around robotics data scaling, the two-stage pretraining/post-training design, the VLM-based trajectory annotation pipeline, and the scaling plots connecting validation action error to downstream success. For pretraining researchers, the key questions are whether state-transition captions provide a stable training signal, how well a UMI-derived action prior transfers across embodiments, and how predictive offline action error is of real-world task success.

recommendation.zh: 重点看自动标注流水线与两阶段训练recipe，具身多模态预训练的数据配比和监督形式可直接迁移到内部VLM实验。
recommendation.en: Focus on the auto-labeling pipeline and two-stage training recipe; the data mixture and supervision design for embodied VLA pretraining are directly transferable to internal VLM ablations.

paper.title: RxBrain: Embodied Cognition Foundation Model with Joint Language-Visual Reasoning and Imagination
paper.abstract: Embodied cognition requires agents to connect high-level task reasoning with the physical states to be achieved. We introduce Hy-Embodied-RxBrain, an embodied cognition foundation model with joint language-visual reasoning and imagination. Unlike vision-language models that emphasize scene understanding and textual decision making, or generative world models that mainly predict future visual states, RxBrain represents embodied plans in a single planning sequence where language and visual imagina

summary.core_problem: 把具身任务中的“语言规划”与“视觉想象/世界状态预测”统一到一个基础模型里，形成可执行的计划序列表示。
summary.importance: 属于多模态/具身统一建模方向：把 plan 表示成跨语言与视觉的序列，有潜力影响多模态预训练目标与 token 统一方式，但是否有扎实的预训练贡献取决于训练细节与规模。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hy-Embodied-RxBrain：用统一 planning sequence 表达计划；语言给出抽象结构（分解、约束、时序、决策逻辑），视觉“想象”负责中间/最终物理状态预测与子目标落地；采用 unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers 架构以支持语言/图像/视频理解与生成式想象。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露参数规模、预训练数据与训练配方；也未给出与主流 VLM/世界模型/具身基线的量化提升幅度，当前只能按“架构与表示思路”给中等相关性。

summary_en.core_problem: Unify language planning and visual imagination/world-state prediction into a single foundation model for embodied planning sequences.
summary_en.importance: Relevant to unified multimodal modeling for embodiment; could inform pretraining objectives and token unification, but the actual pretraining contribution hinges on missing scale/recipe details.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hy-Embodied-RxBrain represents plans as a single sequence: language encodes abstract plan structure (decomposition, constraints, temporal order, decision logic) while visual imagination predicts intermediate/final physical states and supports subgoal planning; uses a unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers architecture for language/image/video understanding and generation-like imagination.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks model size, pretraining data/recipe, and quantified comparisons against strong VLM/world-model/embodied baselines, so relevance is mainly conceptual.

recommendation.zh: 把“计划=跨语言+视觉状态的单序列”讲得清楚，但训练规模与对比缺失；只读架构/表示那部分，别指望拿到可复用 recipe。
recommendation.en: The “plan as a single multimodal sequence” idea is clear, but scale/recipe and clean baselines are missing; read for representation/architecture only, not for reusable training recipes.

paper.title: AspectCLIP: Optimizing CLIP Representation Space via Aspect-Guided Consistency Regularization
paper.abstract: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining learns a shared representation space through large-scale contrastive learning. However, existing methods that enforce global consistency regularization overlook a key challenge: the inherent information asymmetry between images and text: captions typically describe only one specific aspect of an image, thus images with similar visual content can be paired with completely divergent textual content and semantic information. Consequently, global regularizers i

summary.core_problem: 该工作关注 CLIP 训练中的表示空间一致性问题：已有一致性正则通常把 batch 内样本做全局几何约束，但网页图文对存在明显的信息不对称。图像包含多个可描述方面，caption 往往只覆盖其中一个方面。视觉相近的两张图，配对文本可能分别描述物体类别、背景、风格或属性。若强行让图像距离和文本距离保持全局一致，会把“视觉相近但文本方面不同”的样本错误绑定，给表示空间引入语义噪声。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 VLM 目标函数设计上。它不是扩大数据或换 backbone，而是指出多模态对比学习中的正则项需要尊重图文配对的 one-to-many 结构。这个判断对 CLIP 类双塔模型、图文混合预训练、以及更广义的跨模态统一建模都有参考意义：正则化不能只看 embedding 几何，还要考虑监督信号的语义覆盖范围。贡献量级偏方法修正，不是新的预训练范式，但问题抓得比较准。
summary.technical_approach: AspectCLIP 的核心做法是把一致性正则从“全局样本级约束”改成“aspect-aware 约束”。具体地，先只用文本 caption 做语义聚类，使用 SimCSE 表示 caption 语义，并将预训练样本划分到若干属性簇。文本被用来定义图像当前被描述的方面，而不是试图从图像中枚举所有视觉属性。随后正则项分两类处理：簇内样本被认为描述方面相近，可以施加完整的 cyclic consistency，即更严格地约束图像-图像、文本-文本、图文之间的几何关系；簇间样本被认为存在方面差异，不再做直接的样本到样本一致性，而是通过簇 prototype 做较弱的结构对齐。这样可以保留跨簇的高层信息交换，同时避免把不同描述方面的细节硬对齐。它与 CyCLIP 这类全局一致性方法的区别在于：CyCLIP 默认所有样本对都适合做几何一致性，AspectCLIP 先判断文本方面是否一致，再决定约束强度。
summary.experiments: 实验部分围绕 CLIP 下游能力和表示空间一致性展开，任务包括 zero-shot classification、zero-shot retrieval、linear probing 等 CLIP 常用评估。摘要和正文片段显示，AspectCLIP 在多个下游任务上相对传统一致性正则方法有稳定提升，并通过更高的一致性分数说明表示空间结构更规整。可确认的关键消融方向包括：文本语义聚类是否必要、簇内样本级正则与簇间 prototype 正则各自的贡献、以及 aspect-guided 约束相对全局约束的差异。当前给出的全文内容未包含具体数据表，因此不宜补写具体提升幅度、数据规模或模型参数量。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 Fig. 1 和 Fig. 2，对问题设定很关键：它们说明为什么视觉相似不等于文本方面一致。Method 中需要重点看三处：caption clustering 的实现、intra-cluster consistency 的 loss、inter-cluster prototype consistency 的 loss。实验部分优先看与 CyCLIP 等全局正则方法的对比，以及聚类数量、prototype 设计、去掉簇内/簇间正则的消融。如果关注大规模 VLM 预训练，可以重点思考一个问题：这种离线文本聚类在 web-scale 数据上是否稳定，是否会引入语言模型偏置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a geometry problem in CLIP-style contrastive pretraining. Existing consistency regularizers often impose global constraints over image and text embeddings, but web image-text pairs are asymmetric: an image contains many describable attributes, while its caption usually mentions only one aspect. Two images can be visually similar while their paired captions describe different aspects such as object category, background, color, or artistic style. Enforcing global distance consistency over such pairs can inject semantic noise into the representation space.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is in objective design for vision-language pretraining. The paper does not propose a new backbone or a new data scaling recipe. Its useful point is more specific: regularization in multimodal contrastive learning should respect the one-to-many nature of image-caption supervision. This matters for CLIP-like dual encoders and also for broader multimodal pretraining, where alignment losses can be harmful if they ignore what part of one modality is actually supervised by the other.
summary_en.technical_approach: AspectCLIP replaces unconstrained global consistency with aspect-guided consistency. It first clusters captions using SimCSE embeddings, relying on text semantics to identify the aspect of the image being described. Samples within the same cluster are treated as aspect-coherent, while samples from different clusters are treated as potentially aspect-divergent. The regularizer is then split into two regimes. Within a cluster, the method applies full cyclic consistency at the sample level, strengthening fine-grained geometric alignment for a shared descriptive aspect. Across clusters, it avoids direct sample-to-sample constraints and instead aligns samples with cluster prototypes, which gives a weaker and smoother cross-aspect constraint. Compared with CyCLIP-style global regularization, the key change is not the presence of a consistency term, but the decision rule for when strict consistency is semantically appropriate.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate standard CLIP capabilities, including zero-shot classification, zero-shot retrieval, and linear probing, together with representation consistency metrics. The available text states that AspectCLIP consistently improves over traditional consistency regularizers and yields higher consistency scores, suggesting a more structured shared embedding space. The important ablations are expected to test text clustering, intra-cluster regularization, inter-cluster prototype alignment, and the difference between aspect-guided and global constraints. The provided full-text excerpt does not include numerical tables, so exact parameter sizes, data scale, and performance deltas should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 in the introduction, since they define the failure mode of global regularization. Then read the method sections on caption clustering, intra-cluster consistency, and inter-cluster prototype consistency. In the experiments, focus on comparisons against CyCLIP-like regularizers and on ablations over cluster design and loss components. For large-scale VLM pretraining, the main question to keep in mind is whether offline text-semantic clustering remains reliable and cost-effective at web scale.

recommendation.zh: CLIP对齐正则的针对性改进，重点看§3的方面聚类和组内约束设计，可迁移到VLM预训练的图文对齐loss中
recommendation.en: Targeted improvement to CLIP alignment regularization; focus on §3 for aspect clustering and intra-group constraint design, transferable to VLM pretraining alignment losses

paper.title: Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0: Efficient Physical-World Agents
paper.abstract: Building capable embodied agents requires not only multimodal perception and understanding, but also agentic capabilities for reasoning about actions, adapting to evolving situations, and interacting with the physical world. In this report, we introduce Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0, an efficient and powerful embodied foundation model specifically designed for embodied agents operating in the physical world. To cultivate such capabilities from the pre-training stage onward, we define an action-centric cap

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是通用 VLM 的感知问答，而是“物理世界 agent 需要什么能力、如何把这些能力系统地灌进一个高效模型里”。更具体地说，作者面对的是 embodied 场景里常见的断层：普通 VLM 能看懂图像、能做一些语言推理，但对动作相关状态、环境变化、交互后果、长时序修复与恢复这几类能力支持不足，导致模型难以稳定迁移到导航、操作、交互式决策等真实物理任务中。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要不在某个单点算法，而在“能力 taxonomy → 数据构造 → 训练配比 → 评测闭环”这一整套方法。它把 embodied 预训练从泛化的图文理解，推进到动作中心的能力建模。对做多模态预训练的人，价值有三点：第一，说明物理世界 agent 的数据组织不能只靠堆图文对，必须围绕 action-relevant state、transition、sequential adaptation 分层设计；第二，说明高效 MoE VLM 可以在较低激活参数下保留较强 embodied 能力，这对部署敏感场景有现实意义；第三，它把 benchmark 设计和训练目标对齐得比较紧，适合作为后续做 native multimodal / embodied pretrain 时的参考框架。若只从纯文本 LLM 角度看，这篇论文不是核心必读；但从统一多模态基座、物理世界预训练和 post-train 接口角度看，它有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两条主线。第一条是能力分层驱动的数据与训练设计。作者提出三层 taxonomy：Action-Relevant State Understanding、Action-Transition Reasoning、Sequential and Adaptive Reasoning。第一层覆盖物体/部件/属性/状态、深度与度量、3D 结构、视角与位姿、机器人中心线索、affordance 等；第二层强调动作理解、局部状态转移、交互后果和物理约束；第三层处理长时序规划、导航、反思、修复和恢复。这个 taxonomy 不是只拿来写 benchmark，而是直接指导 pre-training 与 post-training 的数据管线和 mixture 设计。也就是说，作者试图把“需要什么能力”前置到数据生产与配比，而不是训练完再靠下游补洞。

第二条是模型架构与效率设计。Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 采用 Hy3-A3B 语言骨干和 Hy-ViT2 视觉编码器，并使用 MoE 架构来控制推理成本。文中强调只有 3B activated parameters，但整体能力接近上一代更大的 A32B 方案，说明它更像是在总参数和激活参数之间做了面向部署的折中。这里的关键不是 MoE 本身新，而是把 MoE 放在 embodied VLM 上，目标明确指向低延迟 physical-world agent。与很多只追求离线 benchmark 的 embodied 模型不同，这篇工作从一开始就把 latency-sensitive deployment 作为约束。

从全文给出的信息看，作者还把训练分成 pre-train 和 post-train 两段，并用 taxonomy 去约束数据混合。虽然公开内容里没有把每一类数据规模、采样权重、课程策略完全展开到可复现程度，但可以看出他们不是简单拼接现成 VQA、导航、机器人数据，而是在能力层级上做覆盖和配平。这一点比单纯报一个总 token 数更有信息量。它隐含的判断是：embodied 能力缺口首先是训练信号结构问题，其次才是模型容量问题。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最重要的是评测覆盖和效率对比。作者把评测扩展到 38 个 benchmark，覆盖三层能力 taxonomy。与同规模近期模型 Qwen3.6-A3B、NVIDIA Cosmos 3-8B、Embodied-R1.5-8B 对比时，Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 在 38 个 benchmark 中有 19 个第一、11 个第二，三类能力平均分也最高，平均领先最强对手 Qwen3.6-A3B 4.4%。相对上一代 Hy-Embodied-0.5 MoT-2B，平均提升 8.4%。

效率是另一个关键数字。文中强调该模型仅用 3B 激活参数，约为上一代 A32B 的十分之一，但整体性能接近。这说明作者在 embodied 场景下把“能力/时延/激活开销”三者做了比较有效的平衡。对真实机器人或交互系统，这比单纯扩大总参数更有意义。

在更接近 agent 的任务上，作者还评测了视觉语言导航。R2R-CE 上，在 RGB-only 设置下达到当时最优；在 Matterport3D Object Goal Navigation 上表现出较强 zero-shot 能力。这里值得注意的是，导航结果被作者当作 taxonomy 第三层能力的外部验证：如果模型真的学到了动作序列、环境反馈和恢复能力，它应该能迁移到更强交互性的环境中，而不只是做静态图像问答。

不过从预训练研究者角度，也要看到实验的边界。文中给了总体平均提升和 benchmark 排名，但若想判断“到底是 taxonomy 数据设计起主要作用，还是 backbone / MoE / post-train 起主要作用”，还需要更细的消融，例如不同能力层数据去除、pre/post 比例变化、MoE 与 dense 对照、导航能力对静态数据比例的敏感性等。公开内容里这部分信息有限。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先抓三处。第一看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，对三层 capability taxonomy 建立清晰心智模型。这是全文真正的主轴。第二看 Data and Taxonomy 部分，重点不是记子任务名，而是看作者如何把能力定义映射到数据构造与 mixture；如果你做多模态预训练，这部分最有参考价值。第三看实验总表和导航实验，关注两件事：一是 38 个 benchmark 的覆盖是否真的对应 taxonomy；二是 3B activated parameters 与上一代大模型的效率对比。

如果阅读时间有限，30 分钟内可以完成一轮泛读：Introduction、taxonomy 图、主实验表、导航结果、结论。若要深挖，建议带着两个问题读：作者的数据 mixture 到底在补什么能力缺口；MoE 在 embodied 场景里是单纯省算力，还是也改变了能力分工。真正值得深挖的点不是某个 benchmark 分数，而是这套“能力定义先行”的训练组织方式能否迁移到更广义的 native multimodal pretrain。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about generic VLM perception or visual QA. It targets a more specific gap: what capabilities a physical-world agent actually needs, and how to train an efficient foundation model around those capabilities. The central issue is that standard VLMs can perceive and answer, but they are weak at action-relevant state understanding, reasoning over environment transitions, and maintaining adaptive behavior over long interaction horizons. That gap limits transfer to navigation, manipulation, and embodied decision-making.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is methodological rather than algorithmic. The paper builds a fairly explicit loop from capability taxonomy to data construction, training mixture, and evaluation. That is useful for anyone working on multimodal pretraining beyond static image-text alignment. Three takeaways matter. First, embodied pretraining cannot be reduced to scaling generic image-text corpora; the data has to be organized around action-relevant state, transitions, and sequential adaptation. Second, an MoE VLM with low activated parameters can still retain strong embodied competence, which matters for latency-constrained deployment. Third, the evaluation suite is aligned with the training taxonomy, making the work a practical template for native multimodal or embodied foundation model development. For pure text pretraining this is peripheral; for unified multimodal pretraining it is relevant.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two main components. The first is a capability-driven data and training design. The authors define a three-level taxonomy: Action-Relevant State Understanding, Action-Transition Reasoning, and Sequential and Adaptive Reasoning. The first level covers object parts, attributes, states, depth, metric estimation, 3D structure, viewpoint and pose, robot-centric cues, and affordances. The second level focuses on actions, local state transitions, interaction consequences, and physical constraints. The third level moves to long-horizon planning, navigation, reflection, repair, and recovery. Importantly, this taxonomy is not only used for evaluation. It is used to guide both pre-training and post-training data pipelines and mixtures.

The second component is the model design. Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 combines the Hy3-A3B language backbone with the Hy-ViT2 vision encoder and adopts an MoE architecture to keep inference efficient. The paper emphasizes 3B activated parameters while maintaining performance close to a much larger previous-generation system. The architectural novelty is limited in isolation, but the design choice is deliberate: the model is built for embodied deployment where latency matters.

From the full text, the training recipe appears to be split into pre-training and post-training stages, both informed by the taxonomy. The paper does not fully expose all mixture ratios or data scales at a level that would make the pipeline fully reproducible, but the intent is clear: the authors are not simply concatenating existing VQA, navigation, and robotics datasets. They are trying to balance training signals according to capability coverage. That is a meaningful design decision. It suggests that embodied performance bottlenecks are treated first as a training-signal organization problem, not only as a model-capacity problem.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important experimental contribution is the breadth of evaluation and the efficiency-performance trade-off. The model is evaluated on 38 benchmarks spanning the three capability levels. Against recent comparable-scale systems including Qwen3.6-A3B, NVIDIA Cosmos 3-8B, and Embodied-R1.5-8B, Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 ranks first on 19 benchmarks and second on 11. It also achieves the best average score across all three capability categories, outperforming the strongest competitor, Qwen3.6-A3B, by 4.4% on average. Relative to Hy-Embodied-0.5 MoT-2B, the average gain is 8.4%.

Efficiency is another key result. The model uses only 3B activated parameters, roughly one tenth of the previous A32B system, while delivering nearly comparable overall performance. For embodied systems, that is more informative than total parameter count alone.

The paper also evaluates on vision-and-language navigation tasks. On R2R-CE, it reports the best result in the RGB-only setting. On Matterport3D Object Goal Navigation, it shows strong zero-shot transfer. These results are used as evidence that the model is not only improving on static perception benchmarks but is also learning capabilities related to sequential interaction and adaptation.

That said, from a pretraining perspective, the ablation story appears incomplete in the public text. The paper reports strong aggregate gains, but it is harder to isolate how much comes from the taxonomy-driven data design versus the backbone, the MoE architecture, or post-training. More granular ablations on data mixture, capability-level removal, dense versus MoE, and pretrain/post-train balance would have made the causal picture clearer.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the taxonomy figure carefully. That is the conceptual center of the paper. Second, read the Data and Taxonomy section with attention to how capability definitions are translated into data construction and mixture design. That is the most useful part for multimodal pretraining researchers. Third, inspect the main benchmark table and the navigation results, especially the relation between benchmark coverage and the three capability levels, and the comparison between 3B activated parameters and the previous larger model.

A 30-minute skim is enough to extract the main ideas: introduction, taxonomy figure, main results table, navigation section, and conclusion. If reading more deeply, keep two questions in mind. What capability gaps is the data mixture trying to close? And in this setting, is MoE only reducing compute, or is it also enabling a more useful specialization pattern for embodied reasoning? The most interesting part is not any single benchmark score, but the training organization principle behind the model.

recommendation.zh: 只看 taxonomy 和 data mixture 章节；3B 级 embodied VLM 的取舍有参考，benchmark 结论别当 scaling 信号。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and data-mixture sections; the 3B embodied-VLM trade-offs are useful, but do not treat the benchmarks as scaling evidence.

paper.title: Accurate, Interdisciplinary and Transparent Structure-property Understanding with Deep Native Structural Reasoning
paper.abstract: Structure-property relationships are foundational to biology, chemistry and materials science, where function, reactivity and physical response emerge from spatial, chemical and periodic organization. Mechanistically explaining these relationships requires interpreting structural evidence through scientific principles and physical constraints, from stereochemistry and bonding to symmetry, energetics and periodic order. However, applying artificial intelligence to this process presents a joint ch

summary.core_problem: 研究如何让模型在蛋白质、小分子和无机晶体等科学结构上进行原生结构推理，并解释结构证据如何支持性质判断。
summary.importance: 贡献偏向科学多模态 foundation model 和结构 tokenization。它的任务域较垂直，但统一坐标、拓扑和周期连接的离散词表设计，对把非文本结构纳入 LM 预训练有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SciReasoner，将坐标、拓扑关系和周期性连接离散化为统一的 structure-aware vocabulary，把结构 token 作为可寻址的推理对象。模型面向蛋白质、小分子和无机晶体三类结构，试图在统一 token 空间中保留几何、化学和周期约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、评测任务、baseline 或数值结果。可确认的是实验目标覆盖结构-性质理解，并强调跨生物、化学和材料体系的统一结构推理与透明解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies native structural reasoning over proteins, small molecules, and inorganic crystals, with explanations linking structural evidence to property predictions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a scientific multimodal foundation model and a structural tokenization scheme. Although the application domain is specialized, the unified discretization of coordinates, topology, and periodic connectivity is relevant to bringing non-text structures into LM-style pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SciReasoner discretizes coordinates, topologies, and periodic connectivities into a unified structure-aware vocabulary, treating structural tokens as addressable reasoning units. The model targets proteins, small molecules, and inorganic crystals in a shared token space that preserves geometric, chemical, and periodic constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, training data scale, benchmark names, baselines, or quantitative results. The stated evaluation scope covers structure-property understanding and transparent reasoning across biology, chemistry, and materials systems.

recommendation.zh: 看 tokenizer 设计即可；科学任务结果不必细读，真正可迁移的是结构离散化接口。
recommendation.en: Only inspect the tokenizer design; the science-task results are secondary, and the transferable part is the structural discretization interface.

paper.title: Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling: Modality Separation and Semantic Coherence for Full-Duplex SLMs
paper.abstract: Developing seamless, high-performance, native intelligent full-duplex Spoken Language Models (SLMs) remains a critical challenge and long-standing goal for the speech and NLP community. Despite notable progress, recent endeavors are fundamentally constrained by severe modality interference, which causes substantial knowledge degradation and compromises semantic integrity -- ultimately making full-duplex SLMs feel unnatural and unintelligent. In this paper, through an exhaustive fine-grained anal

summary.core_problem: 全双工 Spoken Language Model（边听边说）在从半双工模型适配到端到端架构时，会出现严重的“模态干扰”：语音建模与语义建模共享深层参数空间导致知识退化、语义完整性下降。论文要解决的是：在不引入复杂多阶段训练、且不显著增加推理延迟的前提下，缓解声学与语义目标的优化冲突，做出更自然的全双工 SLM。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发点主要在“训练动态与梯度冲突诊断”而不是具体任务本身。它把多模态/多目标训练里常见的退化问题，落到可量化的梯度几何分析（cosine similarity、梯度幅度比），并据此做结构化的参数隔离与语义锚定。这类分析框架可迁移到：语音-文本统一建模、VLM 的视觉-语言联合训练、以及任何 token 密度差异极大的多目标训练（稀疏语义 token vs 稠密帧级 token）。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 根因分析：
- 优化方向冲突：逐层计算语义目标与声学目标的梯度余弦相似度，发现浅层较协同，深层逐渐正交甚至负相关，说明共享深层参数会把优化轨迹拉裂。
- 语义稀释（semantic dilution）：由于文本 token 频率低（文中举例 3Hz）而音频帧密度高（25Hz），用 padding 对齐会让声学梯度在幅度上长期占优，抑制语义梯度。
2) Lychee-FD 架构：
- 分层参数分离：把深层拆成独立的 acoustic head 与 semantic head，并行执行以保持原始深度与推理效率，目标是减少深层梯度冲突。
- 语义对齐通道：引入连续文本监督作为“语义锚”，生成 coherent internal monologues，用来对抗语义稀释，保证训练时语义信号不断流。
整体思路是：先用梯度诊断定位冲突发生在“深层 + 梯度幅度失衡”，再用最小结构改动做隔离与锚定，而不是走 Thinker-Talker 那种多阶段、系统复杂度更高的路线。
summary.experiments:
文中给出的关键数字：
- 相比基线，Spoken QA 平均提升 7.4%。
- 在 FullDuplexBench 1.5 上提升 28.5%。
- 引用 Moshi 报告：全双工对齐后 speech intelligence 在 LlamaQ 上下降 12.7%（作为问题背景佐证）。
当前片段未包含：模型规模、训练数据与时长、与 Thinker-Talker 或其他端到端方法的完整对比表、以及对两项创新（head 分离 vs 语义通道）的消融贡献占比。若全文有这些消融与效率（RTF/latency）数据，它们决定该方法是否真做到“效率与保真兼得”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看梯度分析图（layer-wise cosine similarity、gradient magnitude ratio）：这是论文最可迁移的部分，能直接复用到其他多模态预训练诊断。
- 再看架构图：确认 head 分离发生在哪些层、并行执行如何实现、是否影响 KV-cache/流式生成。
- 最后扫实验主表与消融：重点找 latency/吞吐与质量的 trade-off。
预计 30–45 分钟可完成一次有效泛读；若要复现或迁移到其他模态，再回头精读训练细节与损失定义。

summary_en.core_problem: Native full-duplex Spoken Language Models (listening while speaking) often suffer from severe modality interference when adapting half-duplex bases into end-to-end full-duplex architectures: shared deep parameters cause knowledge degradation and semantic incoherence. The paper aims to mitigate this interference without resorting to complex multi-stage Thinker–Talker pipelines or adding substantial inference latency.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is mainly methodological: it turns a vague “multimodal interference” complaint into measurable optimization dynamics (gradient cosine similarity and magnitude imbalance), then designs architectural separation guided by that diagnosis. The analysis is transferable to other multi-objective settings with token-density mismatch (sparse semantic tokens vs dense frame-level tokens), including speech-text unified LMs and some VLM training regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Optimization-dynamics diagnosis:
- Directional conflict: layer-wise gradient cosine similarity between acoustic and semantic objectives shows shallow-layer synergy but deep-layer orthogonality/negativity, implying shared deep spaces fracture optimization.
- Semantic dilution: aligning low-rate text tokens (example: ~3Hz) with high-rate audio frames (example: ~25Hz) via padding leads to acoustic gradients dominating in magnitude, suppressing semantic learning.
2) Lychee-FD architecture:
- Hierarchical parameter separation: split deep layers into independent acoustic and semantic heads, executed in parallel to preserve depth and efficiency while reducing gradient conflict.
- Semantic alignment channel: add continuous textual supervision as a semantic anchor, producing coherent internal monologues to counter semantic dilution.
The key choice is minimal, targeted separation (deep heads + semantic anchoring) rather than heavier multi-stage designs that trade quality for latency and system complexity.
summary_en.experiments:
Numbers explicitly stated in the excerpt:
- +7.4% average improvement on Spoken QA tasks.
- +28.5% on FullDuplexBench 1.5.
- Cites Moshi reporting a -12.7% drop on LlamaQ after full-duplex alignment (context/motivation).
Missing from the excerpt (likely in the full paper) are: model size, training data/compute, full baselines including Thinker–Talker variants, ablations separating the contribution of head separation vs semantic channel, and latency/RTF measurements. Those are essential to validate the “efficiency + retention” claim.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Start with the gradient analysis figures (layer-wise cosine similarity and magnitude ratios). This is the most reusable part for diagnosing multimodal pretraining issues.
- Then read the architecture section to see where the split happens and how parallel heads interact with streaming generation.
- Finally, scan the main results and ablations, focusing on quality–latency trade-offs.
A focused skim should take ~30–45 minutes; deeper reading is only needed if you plan to port the recipe to another modality.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是“梯度冲突→分层解耦”这条因果链，不只是语音系统；若你在做统一多模态 pretrain，先看分析图和共享/分离 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read it for the causal chain from gradient conflict to hierarchical decoupling, not for the speech product angle; the analysis and sharing-vs-separation ablations are the useful parts.

paper.title: iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni Technical Report
paper.abstract: General-purpose embodied agents must understand multimodal instructions, anticipate how their environment will evolve, and produce precise control actions over extended horizons. Existing approaches typically specialize in visual-language reasoning, video-based world modeling, or action generation, while cascaded pipelines that first synthesize future observations and then infer actions can introduce interface bottlenecks and compound prediction errors. We present iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni, a unifie

summary.core_problem: 这篇技术报告想解决具身模型里语义理解、未来状态预测和动作生成割裂的问题，尤其是级联式“先生成未来视频、再用逆动力学推动作”带来的接口瓶颈和误差累积。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在统一多模态建模，而不是纯机器人控制。它把图像、视频、语言和动作放进一个共享注意力框架中训练，说明“动作”可以被当作一种可生成模态，与视觉世界模型和语言规划共同对齐。对做跨模态预训练的人，值得关注的是三点：一是动作标注数据和无动作 embodied video 如何混合；二是视频生成目标如何为动作策略提供环境动态信号；三是为什么保留模态专用模块，同时用共享 self-attention 做信息交换，而不是把所有 token 简单拼在一起建模。论文更偏系统整合，预训练范式上的新意有限，但方向和训练 recipe 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 模型被组织成一个 Omni 框架。VLM 和 VGM 被称为高层“brain”，负责语言指令理解、任务规划、进度跟踪和未来视觉状态预测；AGM 被称为低层“cerebellum”，负责把计划或子目标转成动作 chunk。关键设计不是把视频模型、视觉语言模型和动作模型串成流水线，而是让它们在共享 multimodal self-attention 中通信。这样 AGM 可以直接读取语言语义、当前视觉上下文和世界预测相关表示，不必依赖一个显式生成出来的未来图像作为中间接口。论文强调保留各模态专用表示，因为语言、视频和动作的抽象层级、时间粒度、训练目标差异很大；如果完全统一 token 和目标，容易让表示对齐变弱。训练上使用多源混合数据，包括带动作标注的具身视频、无动作具身视频、具身推理与感知数据，以及通用图文数据。训练流程是四阶段：先分别强化 VLM、VGM、AGM 的能力，再做整体联合微调，使理解、世界建模和动作生成逐步对齐。
summary.experiments: 报告给出的关键结果集中在具身操作基准。模型在 zero-shot LIBERO-Plus 上达到 89.6% 平均成功率；在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，Clean 设置为 93.68%，Rand 设置为 93.16%。这些数字支持一个判断：共享上下文下的规划、未来状态预测和动作生成，对多阶段任务和随机扰动场景有帮助。材料中没有给出可核验的模型参数量、各数据源 token 或 episode 规模、训练算力和完整消融数字，因此不宜把结果解读为清晰的 scaling 结论。更应把它看作一个统一 embodied multimodal pretraining recipe：动作生成不是附在 VLM 后面的 policy head，而是参与共享上下文建模的生成模块。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。建议先看 Introduction 中对 VLA、WAM 和级联 pipeline 的问题定义，明确它要避免的接口瓶颈。随后看模型架构图和方法部分，重点关注 VLM/VGM/AGM 如何通过共享 self-attention 连接，以及 AGM 输入中是否使用显式未来帧或隐式上下文表示。训练部分值得看数据混合和四阶段流程，尤其是 action-free video 如何服务于动作模型。实验部分重点看 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0，以及是否有去掉 VGM、去掉共享注意力、改成级联动作推断的消融。如果没有充分消融，结论应限制在系统设计有效性，而不是证明某个建模范式更优。
summary.authors_note: 机构可从标题判断为 iFLYTEK；给定材料未提供完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The report addresses the fragmentation between semantic instruction understanding, future-state prediction, and action generation in embodied models, with a particular focus on avoiding the bottlenecks of cascaded video-to-action pipelines.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining lies in unified multimodal modeling rather than robotics as a downstream task. The work treats actions as a generative modality that can be aligned with language, images, and videos under a shared attention context. For pretraining researchers, the useful parts are the modality mixture, the staged training recipe, and the decision to keep modality-specialized components while allowing information exchange through shared multimodal self-attention. The contribution is more of a system-level integration than a new language modeling objective, but it is informative for native multimodal pretraining that includes control signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni combines a vision-language model, a video generation model, and an action generation model within one Omni framework. The VLM and VGM act as a high-level module for instruction understanding, task planning, progress tracking, and future visual prediction. The AGM serves as a low-level action generator that emits executable action chunks. The main design choice is to avoid a hard cascade where a future video is first generated and an inverse dynamics model then recovers actions. Instead, the action model directly consumes the shared multimodal context. This lets action generation condition on semantic intent and world-dynamics representations without depending on a rendered future frame as an intermediate interface. Training uses a multi-source mixture of action-annotated embodied videos, action-free embodied videos, embodied perception and reasoning data, and general image-text data. A four-stage schedule first specializes the VLM, VGM, and AGM, then jointly fine-tunes the full system.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results are mainly on embodied manipulation benchmarks. The model achieves an average zero-shot success rate of 89.6% on LIBERO-Plus. On RoboTwin 2.0, it reaches 93.68% in the Clean setting and 93.16% in the Rand setting. These results suggest that coupling semantic planning, world prediction, and action generation can help long-horizon execution and robustness to randomized settings. The provided material does not include enough verifiable detail on model size, data scale, compute, or full ablations, so the numbers should not be read as a scaling-law result. The safer takeaway is the training and architectural recipe for including actions in a unified multimodal pretraining stack.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction to understand the stated gap between VLA models, world-action models, and cascaded video-to-action systems. Then inspect the architecture section for how VLM, VGM, and AGM communicate through shared self-attention. The training section is the most relevant part for pretraining researchers: focus on the data mixture and the four-stage schedule, especially how action-free embodied videos are used. In the experiments, look for ablations that remove the video model, remove shared attention, or replace the direct AGM with a cascaded inverse-dynamics setup. Without such ablations, the evidence should be treated as support for the integrated system rather than a definitive comparison of modeling paradigms.
summary_en.authors_note: The title indicates iFLYTEK as the institution; the provided material does not include the full author list.

recommendation.zh: 多模态统一预训练的具身模型技术报告，共享自注意力的跨模态融合设计值得参考，读架构章节即可。
recommendation.en: Technical report on unified multimodal embodied pretraining; shared self-attention cross-modal fusion design is worth referencing, read only the architecture section.

paper.title: Unlocking Speech-Text Compositional Powers: Instruction-Following Speech Language Models without Instruction Tuning
paper.abstract: Instruction tuning for speech language models (SLMs) is substantially more challenging than for text-based large language models (LLMs), as it requires learning a new modality and a wide range of speech-specific instructions in addition to those supported by text LLMs. Existing SLM training approaches largely replicate the text LLM training paradigm by synthesizing large-scale speech pre-training and instruction-tuning datasets. However, this strategy is difficult to scale, since speech sequence

summary.core_problem: 让 speech language model 获得指令跟随能力，同时避免大规模语音指令数据合成和 instruction tuning。
summary.importance: 这是语音 LM 与文本 LLM 后训练能力组合的一种方法创新。它把“模态适配”和“指令能力”拆开处理，对跨模态统一预训练和 pretrain-posttrain 接口有较强参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: SpeechCombine 从 text LLM base 出发，只用 30k 小时语音数据做一轮 speech continual pretraining，得到 speech-adapted model；然后把文本 instruction-tuned 模型与文本 base 模型之间的权重差分，合并到 speech-adapted model 上。核心假设是：语音模态适配可以通过连续预训练学习，指令跟随能力可以通过文本域 instruction delta 迁移。
summary.experiments: 训练数据为 30k 小时语音。摘要称模型无需 speech instruction tuning 即可具备 instruction-following speech LM 能力；具体参数规模、语音 tokenizer、baseline、任务集和提升幅度未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to give speech language models instruction-following ability without synthesizing large-scale speech instruction data or running speech instruction tuning.
summary_en.importance: This is a method-level contribution at the speech-LM and text-LLM interface. It separates modality adaptation from instruction-following transfer, which is directly relevant to multimodal pretraining and the pretrain-to-posttrain boundary.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpeechCombine starts from a text LLM base, performs one round of continual pretraining on 30k hours of speech to obtain a speech-adapted model, and then merges in the weight delta between the instruction-tuned and base versions of the text LLM. The central idea is that speech adaptation can be learned via pretraining, while instruction behavior can be transferred as a text-domain weight difference.
summary_en.experiments: The method uses 30k hours of speech data. The abstract claims instruction-following speech capability without speech instruction tuning, but does not provide model size, tokenizer details, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation；若 delta 迁移稳定成立，会改变语音 LM 是否必须做语音 SFT 的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; stable delta transfer would weaken the prior that speech LMs require speech-specific SFT.

paper.title: Orca: The World is in Your Mind
paper.abstract: We introduce Orca, an initial instantiation of a general world foundation model. Orca learns a unified world latent space from multimodal world signals and exposes it through multimodal readout interfaces. Rather than optimizing isolated next-token, next-frame, or next-action prediction, we are centered on Next-State-Prediction modeling, offering a unified state-transition modeling route toward understanding, predicting, and acting upon the world. Orca learns through two complementary paradigms:

summary.core_problem: 论文试图把“世界建模”从 next-token/next-frame/next-action 这些各自为政的预测任务，统一到 next-state prediction：学习一个可跨模态读出的世界潜状态 S，并建模其在隐式动力学与显式条件（如指令）下的状态转移。核心问题是：能否用大规模视频与事件级语言监督，学到一个可扩展的 world latent space，使得在冻结 backbone 的情况下，通过轻量 readout 就能完成文本、图像与动作等多种输出。
summary.importance:
对 LLM 预训练研究的启发点在“范式”而不在可复现的 recipe：它把预训练目标从 token 级生成推进到状态空间建模，并明确区分两类训练信号——无标注的密集状态转移（unconscious learning）与带语言约束的稀疏事件转移（conscious learning）。这与近期把 AR LM 扩展到统一多模态/世界模型的趋势一致，也与“latent variable + transition”类建模（视频 world model、行动条件生成、以及部分 diffusion/flow 的状态演化视角）在概念上相通。

但从全文片段看，它更像一个宏大系统设想 + 大数据工程 + 探针式 readout 证明，而不是直接给出可迁移到纯文本 LLM 的优化器/损失/数据配比结论。若关注“预训练目标如何组织多模态信号”“冻结 backbone、用 readout 验证表征质量”的研究者，会更有收获。
summary.technical_approach:
Orca 将世界信号 X（当前版本主要是视觉与语言）编码为潜状态 S=f_θ(X)，并学习状态在时间上的前向/后向演化：S_{>t} 或 S_{<t}，同时引入两类因素：
- z_t：不可观测的隐式动力学（物理规律、对象属性、场景动力等）。
- c_t：可观测的显式条件（人类指令/语言约束）。

训练上分两条互补路径：
1) Unconscious learning：从连续视频中学习“密集自然转移”，用自监督方式预测下一时刻的 latent（类似把视频当作状态序列，做 latent-level 的 next-step prediction）。重点是覆盖大量无标注转移，逼迫表征吸收动力学。
2) Conscious learning：用语言描述的事件与 VQA 监督学习“稀疏但有语义的转移”，把状态变化与决策/任务结果对齐。

读出层（Decoder/readout）覆盖文本、图像、动作，但作者刻意把它定位为 probing：预训练 backbone 冻结，只训练轻量 readout，用来回答“world latent 是否随规模变强、是否能支撑多种输出”。这点与常见端到端多模态生成（直接追任务指标）不同：它更强调表征与状态空间作为统一接口。
summary.experiments:
数据与规模信息（摘要与正文片段明确给出）：
- 预训练数据：125K 小时视频 + 1.6 亿事件标注（event annotations），覆盖多种场景（自我视角交互、第三视角操作、机器人执行、事件级转移）。
- 结论型结果：训练损失随模型规模与数据规模继续下降；冻结 backbone 后，文本生成、交互式图像预测、具身动作生成等 readout 能力随预训练规模提升而提升；在“可比规模”下优于若干专用基线。

但当前提供的全文片段缺少关键可核对的细节数字：具体模型参数量分档、训练 token/帧数、各 readout 的定量指标与提升幅度、以及 unconscious vs conscious 的消融贡献。要做严肃复盘需要把实验章节的表格与附录补齐后再判断其工程可迁移性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
1) 先读方法总览图与公式定义：S、z_t、c_t、前向/后向预测各自对应什么训练任务，避免停留在口号。
2) 重点看两种学习范式的具体实现：unconscious 的预测目标是在像素、离散 token 还是 latent；conscious 的事件标注如何组织成条件与监督。
3) 实验部分优先核对三件事：
- scaling：loss/能力随模型与数据的曲线是否平滑、是否有拐点；
- probing 设计：冻结 backbone 的 readout 训练预算是否公平，是否排除了“readout 太强掩盖 backbone”的可能；
- 消融：去掉 conscious 或 unconscious 后，哪些能力掉得最明显。

如果时间有限，只看：数据构成与标注定义 + scaling 曲线 + 冻结 readout 的对比表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes to unify disparate prediction paradigms (next-token / next-frame / next-action) into next-state prediction: learn a latent world state space S from multimodal signals and model state transitions under implicit dynamics and explicit conditions (e.g., language instructions). The key question is whether large-scale video plus event-level language supervision can produce a scalable world latent that supports multiple downstream readouts (text, image, action) with a frozen backbone and lightweight decoders.
summary_en.importance:
Its value to LLM pretraining researchers is mainly paradigm-level: it reframes pretraining around state-space representation and transitions, and explicitly separates two supervision regimes—dense unlabeled transitions vs. sparse semantically meaningful event transitions. This aligns with broader trends toward unified multimodal/world models and latent-transition modeling.

However, it is less about transferable training recipes (optimizer, data mixture for text LMs, tokenizer choices, stability tricks) and more about a large system + data inventory + probing-style validation. Readers interested in how to organize multimodal pretraining objectives and how to evaluate representation quality via frozen-backbone readouts will get the most out of it.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Orca encodes world signals X (in this version, primarily vision and language) into a latent state S = f_θ(X), and learns forward/backward evolution of states over time. Two factors are introduced:
- z_t for unobserved/implicit dynamics (physics, object properties, scene dynamics).
- c_t for observed/explicit conditions (instructions).

Training uses two complementary paradigms:
1) Unconscious learning: self-supervised learning from continuous videos to capture dense natural transitions, implemented as predicting next-step latents (latent-level temporal prediction rather than explicit semantic supervision).
2) Conscious learning: instruction- and event-conditioned learning using language-described events and VQA supervision to model sparse but meaningful transitions tied to decisions and outcomes.

A notable design choice is evaluation via readouts: the backbone is frozen during decoder post-training, and only lightweight readout modules are trained for text/image/action outputs. This positions the decoders as probes of the learned world latent rather than task-optimized generators.
summary_en.experiments:
Confirmed scale/data from the provided content:
- Pretraining inventory: 125K hours of video and 160M event annotations, spanning egocentric interaction, exocentric manipulation, robot execution, and event-level transitions.
- Reported qualitative conclusions: training losses keep decreasing with model/data scale; frozen-backbone readouts for text generation, interactive image prediction, and embodied action generation improve with scaling; at comparable scale, Orca outperforms specialized baselines.

What is not verifiable from the current excerpt (and should be checked in the full experimental section/appendix): exact parameter scales, compute budget, metrics per readout task, absolute/relative gains, and ablations isolating unconscious vs. conscious learning contributions.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the framework figure and the formal definition of S, z_t, c_t, and forward/backward prediction to avoid staying at the slogan level.
- Read the concrete objective implementations: whether unconscious learning predicts pixels, discrete tokens, or latents; how conscious learning structures event annotations into conditions and supervision.
- In experiments, prioritize: (1) scaling curves, (2) frozen-backbone probing protocol and fairness of readout training budget, (3) ablations removing either learning paradigm.

If time is tight: data/annotation definition + scaling plots + the main readout comparison table.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在想 AR token prediction 之外还能怎样统一多模态预训练，这篇值得看任务定义和数据接口；先读方法图和数据构成，别急着信“world model”口号。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the objective shift from token prediction to state-transition modeling; focus on the formulation and data interface first, not the world-model branding.

paper.title: ViQ: Text-Aligned Visual Quantized Representations at Any Resolution
paper.abstract: A unified representation for text and vision is a natural pursuit, as it enables simpler multimodal modeling and more efficient training. However, representing images as discrete signals in the same way as text inevitably introduces severe information loss. Existing work struggles to balance low-level details and high-level semantics in discrete representations: reconstruction-oriented representations often lack semantic information, whereas semantically stronger features typically suffer from s

summary.core_problem: 离散视觉表示要同时服务语言对齐、跨任务理解和图像重构，长期面临语义强则细节差、重构强则语义弱的矛盾；此外固定分辨率限制了其在原生分辨率输入场景中的通用性。
summary.importance: 对统一离散多模态建模有直接参考价值。论文试图把视觉离散 tokenizer 做到接近连续视觉编码器的任务表现，同时保留重构能力和任意分辨率支持，这对 AR 统一生成/理解模型、视觉 token 进入统一词表、以及降低多模态训练开销都很相关。不过从提供内容看，其主要验证仍停留在“作为视觉编码器接入 LLM”的理解任务，距离真正统一原生生成建模还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: ViQ 采用两阶段训练。第一阶段做文本对齐预训练，在连续特征空间先把视觉编码器训练到具备较强跨模态语义对齐能力；这里借鉴 NaViT/OryxViT 的任意分辨率适配，用可动态扩展的位置编码和变长 token 处理支持原生分辨率输入。第二阶段做渐进式量化学习，通过近端正则约束连续隐空间与其量化表示接近，减少量化带来的信息损失；同时引入位置编码增强和扩展视觉特征的量化机制，提升码本容量与分辨率适应性。整体目标不是只做重建 VQ，也不是只做语义对齐特征，而是兼顾两者。
summary.experiments: 在统一微调协议下，ViQ 与 InternViT、AIMv2、SigLIP2 等连续视觉编码器比较，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 作为 backbone LLM。9 个基准聚合平均分为 57.2（1.5B）和 63.9（7B），略优于此前 6B 视觉编码器量级的离散方案，并与主流连续编码器接近。训练效率上，相比常规训练策略带来 20%–70% 的提速，提升幅度随序列长度变化。重建任务上，配合图像解码器微调后达到 PSNR 22.73、rFID 0.62，在主流离散视觉自编码器中表现靠前。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法与实验摘要，重点看两阶段训练目标、任意分辨率处理、以及近端正则/渐进量化这几个设计如何平衡语义和重构。最值得关注的是表或图里与连续编码器的直接对比，以及训练速度提升是否主要来自离散表示缓存与预计算。预计阅读 15–20 分钟。如果关注统一多模态预训练中的视觉 tokenizer，可进一步看它是否支持自回归生成、码本规模和 token 数设置。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete visual representations struggle to jointly support language alignment, multimodal understanding, and image reconstruction: reconstruction-oriented VQ codes often lack semantics, while semantically aligned discrete features usually lose low-level detail. Fixed-resolution training further limits their practical use for native-resolution inputs.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to unified discrete multimodal modeling. It pushes discrete visual tokenizers closer to the performance of strong continuous vision encoders while preserving reconstruction ability and supporting arbitrary resolutions. This matters for AR-based unified understanding/generation models, integrating visual tokens into a shared vocabulary, and reducing multimodal training cost. Based on the provided content, however, validation is still centered on using ViQ as a visual encoder for LLM understanding tasks, rather than full native multimodal generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: ViQ uses a two-stage training recipe. Stage 1 is text-aligned pretraining in continuous feature space, so the vision encoder first acquires strong cross-modal semantic alignment. To support arbitrary resolutions, it adopts NaViT/OryxViT-style dynamic positional embeddings and variable-length token processing for native-resolution inputs. Stage 2 introduces progressive visual quantization. A proximal representation learning objective constrains the continuous latent space to stay close to its quantized counterpart, reducing information loss from discretization. The quantizer is further enhanced with position encoding and expanded visual features to improve codebook capacity and resolution robustness. The design explicitly tries to balance semantic alignment and visual fidelity rather than optimizing for only one of them.
summary_en.experiments: Under a consistent fine-tuning protocol with Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B as backbones, ViQ is compared with continuous vision encoders including InternViT, AIMv2, and SigLIP2. On an aggregate of nine benchmarks, it reports average scores of 57.2 with the 1.5B LLM and 63.9 with the 7B LLM, marginally ahead of prior quantized encoders in the 6B vision-encoder regime and competitive with mainstream continuous encoders. Training speed is improved by 20%–70% depending on sequence length. For reconstruction, after fine-tuning with an image decoder it achieves PSNR 22.73 and rFID 0.62, placing it near the top among mainstream discrete visual autoencoders.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the method and result sections, focusing on three design choices: the two-stage training objective, arbitrary-resolution support, and the proximal/progressive quantization used to balance semantics and reconstruction. The most important comparison is against continuous encoders under the same LLM and training recipe. Also pay attention to whether the reported training speedups come mainly from precomputation/caching enabled by discrete representations. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes. Readers interested in visual tokenizers for unified multimodal pretraining should check codebook size, visual token count, and whether the representation is actually used autoregressively for generation.

recommendation.zh: 视觉 Tokenizer 的重要改进，尝试解决语义与细节的 trade-off 并支持任意分辨率，对做 native multimodal pretrain 的研究员有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Important improvement in visual tokenizers, attempting to solve the semantics vs. details trade-off and supporting arbitrary resolutions. Valuable reference for researchers working on native multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: Does Translation-Enhanced Speech Encoder Pre-training Affect Speech LLMs?
paper.abstract: Connecting a pre-trained speech encoder to a Large Language Model (LLM) is the standard architecture for building Speech LLMs. However, a structural misalignment exists between the encoder and the LLM. Unlike encoders based on automatic speech recognition, which often produce representations in separate language-specific spaces, LLMs operate within a unified language-agnostic space. A mechanism is required to align the encoder's language-specific representations with the LLM's shared space. We a

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：Speech LLM 中的语音编码器如果主要用 ASR 或 Whisper 式单向翻译目标预训练，是否会留下语言相关的表示空间，从而增加与冻结 LLM 语义空间的对齐难度。作者重点考察英语输入，因为原始 Whisper 范式通常只对非英语语音做翻译到英语，英语语音主要做转写，可能没有被迫学习跨语言语义抽象。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发点在于把 Speech LLM 的性能差异追到语音编码器的预训练目标，而不是只看 adaptor 或指令微调。对预训练研究来说，贡献不在新架构，而在一个清晰的训练目标假设：翻译目标比转写目标更强地要求模型丢掉语言和音系表层差异，学习更接近 LLM 输入空间的语义表示。这个问题对音频 LM、统一多模态预训练、语音 tokenizer/encoder 设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法采用受控实验设计。模型结构固定为常见 Speech LLM 管线：语音编码器输出连续表示，trainable adaptor 将其投到 LLM embedding 维度，LLM 完全冻结。编码器预训练阶段使用 Whisper 风格的 encoder-decoder Seq2Seq 框架，训练完成后丢弃 decoder，只保留 encoder 接入 LLM。关键对比是三类预训练目标：多语 ASR-only；ASR 加非英语到英语翻译，模拟 Whisper 的训练范式；ASR 加英语双向翻译，即 English-to-any 与 any-to-English 同时引入。作者选择英语、日语、中文、德语四种语言，避免大规模多语训练带来的不可控因素。这个设计的价值在于隔离了 encoder objective 的影响，使下游差异更难被归因到 LLM 更新或 adaptor 容量。
summary.experiments: 实验设置保持 Speech LLM 架构、adaptor 训练和冻结 LLM 不变，只替换不同目标预训练得到的语音编码器。文中报告的主要结论是：加入英语双向翻译目标的编码器，在跨模态对齐和下游 Speech LLM 任务上优于 ASR-only 与 Whisper-style 目标，收益在英语输入上更明显。这支持作者的假设：当英语语音也被要求翻译到其他语言时，编码器需要抽取更语言无关的语义信息，而不是只学习英语音频到英语文本的单语映射。给出的内容没有暴露完整数值表，因此具体提升幅度、任务名和统计显著性需要查阅实验章节。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Research Design 中三种 encoder pre-training configuration 的定义，以及后续实验表中按语言拆分的 Speech LLM 性能。重点关注两点：第一，English-to-any translation 是否只改善英语，还是也改善其他语言；第二，作者是否提供表示分析或 alignment probe，能否证明收益来自语义抽象，而不只是更多训练信号或更多目标文本。若只关心预训练目标设计，可以跳过常规 Speech LLM 架构介绍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the pre-training objective of a speech encoder leaves a structural mismatch when the encoder is attached to a frozen LLM. The specific concern is that ASR-centric or Whisper-style objectives may produce language-specific speech representations, while the LLM expects a more shared semantic space. English input is the key case, because the original Whisper-style recipe usually trains English speech with transcription rather than translation.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pre-training research is the link between encoder objectives and cross-modal alignment. The paper does not mainly propose a new Speech LLM architecture. Its contribution is a controlled argument that speech translation can force language-agnostic semantic abstraction more directly than monolingual transcription. This matters for audio-language pre-training, multimodal connector design, and the choice of speech encoder objectives in unified models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study fixes the downstream Speech LLM pipeline: a pre-trained speech encoder produces continuous acoustic representations, a trainable adaptor projects them into the LLM embedding dimension, and the LLM is kept frozen. The encoder is trained with a Whisper-like encoder-decoder Seq2Seq setup; after pre-training, the decoder is discarded and only the encoder is used. The comparison covers three objective families: multilingual transcription only, transcription plus non-English-to-English translation in the Whisper style, and transcription plus bidirectional English translation. Experiments are restricted to English, Japanese, Chinese, and German to keep the setup controlled and sufficiently resourced per language.
summary_en.experiments: The controlled comparison keeps the Speech LLM architecture, adaptor training, and frozen LLM unchanged, so performance differences mainly reflect the encoder pre-training objective. The reported finding is that bidirectional English translation improves cross-modal alignment and downstream Speech LLM performance over ASR-only and Whisper-style training, with a particularly clear effect on English inputs. The provided content does not include the full numerical tables, so exact task scores, gains, and variance should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the definition of the three encoder pre-training configurations, then inspect the result tables broken down by language and task. The most informative details are whether English-to-any translation improves only English speech or transfers to other languages, and whether the paper includes representation or alignment analyses beyond end-task accuracy. Readers interested only in pre-training objectives can move quickly through the standard Speech LLM architecture description.

recommendation.zh: 翻译目标做语音编码器预训练的思路合理，做Speech LLM跨模态对齐的研究员可重点看§3的目标设计与消融实验。
recommendation.en: Translation objective for speech encoder pre-training is a sound design; Speech LLM alignment researchers should focus on §3's objective design and ablation experiments.

paper.title: FlowTrain: Flow-Based Decoupled Training for Industrial-Grade Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Industrial-grade distributed training of vision-language models (VLMs) remains far less efficient than that of unimodal LLMs. Existing solutions either follow a monolithic design that assigns uniform parallelism to heterogeneous modules or adopt a disaggregated deployment that separates modules while executing them as a batch-synchronized pipeline. In this paper, we highlight that the above solutions are still not sufficient, and VLM training can be further decoupled. To this end, we present Flo

summary.core_problem: 解决工业级 VLM 分布式训练中，视觉编码器与语言主干异构导致的并行策略失配和流水线低效问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是训练系统与并行训练方法创新。虽然对象是 VLM，但问题本质是异构模块的预训练解耦与吞吐匹配，这对原生多模态基座训练和未来非同构 foundation model 训练都很相关。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FlowTrain，把 VLM 训练从 batch-synchronized pipeline 改写为 producer-consumer dataflow，并通过统一内存池和全局虚拟地址空间让 encoder 与 backbone 独立推进。进一步设计 heterogeneous parallel allocator，根据吞吐匹配目标为不同模块分配不同并行策略，并配合调度优化减少等待与资源浪费。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和集群规模，但定位是 industrial-grade VLM distributed training。核心比较对象应包括单体式统一并行方案和模块分离但批同步的 pipeline 方案；论文声称在这些基线上进一步提升训练效率。是否有收敛等价性、吞吐-成本曲线和稳定性分析，是阅读时最该看的部分。
summary.authors_note: 从题目和作者列表看更像工业界系统团队的 VLM 训练基础设施工作；摘要未明确机构，无法可靠确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles inefficiency in industrial-scale distributed VLM training caused by heterogeneous modules requiring mismatched parallelization and scheduling strategies.
