summary_en.importance: This is mainly a training-systems contribution. Although framed around VLMs, the core issue is decoupled pretraining of heterogeneous modules, which is directly relevant to native multimodal foundation-model training and other non-homogeneous pretraining stacks.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlowTrain reformulates VLM training as a producer-consumer dataflow instead of a batch-synchronized pipeline. With a unified memory pool and a global virtual address space, the encoder and backbone can progress independently. On top of that, a heterogeneous parallel allocator assigns module-specific parallel strategies by solving a throughput-matching problem, reducing idle time and resource waste.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model or cluster scale, but the target is industrial-grade distributed VLM training. The key baselines are likely monolithic uniform-parallel training and disaggregated yet batch-synchronized pipelines. The most important things to inspect are convergence equivalence, throughput/cost curves, and stability under decoupled execution.
summary_en.authors_note: From the title and author list, this appears to be an industry systems paper on VLM training infrastructure, but the abstract does not clearly identify the institution.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作对做原生多模态预训练的人比对纯文本更有用；重点看它是否在不改收敛点的前提下解耦执行，若成立，内部训练栈该补异构并行抽象了。
recommendation.en: More useful for native multimodal pretraining than pure-text LLMs; check whether execution is decoupled without changing the convergence target—if yes, your training stack likely needs a heterogeneity-aware parallel abstraction.

paper.title: SPAR: Semantic-Pixel Self-Alignment and Adaptive Routing for Unified Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in visual understanding but remain constrained in visual generation due to the fundamental feature discrepancy between semantic perception and pixel-level reconstruction. Bridging this gap requires overcoming two core challenges: endowing semantic encoders with high-fidelity reconstruction capabilities, and effectively aligning generative models with semantic spaces without relying on external teachers. To this end, we pro

summary.core_problem: 统一多模态模型在视觉理解上表现成熟，但难以原生支持图像生成：语义编码器的判别式特征空间会丢失高频纹理与结构细节，直接在语义空间做生成会出现模糊与结构失真；同时现有方法依赖外部视觉教师（如 DINOv2）做表征对齐，随数据规模扩大容易出现流形错配，无法在统一空间内原生衔接理解与生成。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发集中在三点：一是视觉 tokenizer 的设计可以通过非对称双流结构，在不破坏语义判别能力的前提下恢复像素重建能力，为统一理解-生成的多模态基座提供了表示层方案；二是提出了自对齐范式，用同一个统一 tokenizer 作为生成阶段的对齐教师，去掉对外部特征模型的依赖，降低训练链路的耦合度；三是动态 token 路由机制为多模态 token 如何按需聚合多层特征提供了轻量思路，可迁移到其他多模态预训练架构中。
summary.technical_approach: 整体框架 SPAR 由三部分组成。第一，非对称双流统一 tokenizer：轻量语义流冻结或轻训，保留原始语义编码器的判别特征，作为锚点避免灾难性遗忘；Transformer 增强的像素流负责把高维语义特征映射到紧凑潜空间，专门恢复编码器在损失压缩中丢弃的高频纹理与结构信息；两流在同一个紧凑潜空间融合，显式解耦语义保持与像素重建。第二，自对齐生成范式：双流 tokenizer 训练完成后直接作为扩散模型的对齐教师，把语义与像素知识无缝传递到生成阶段，不再依赖外部独立的视觉表征模型。第三，动态 token 路由 DTR：每个 token 根据自身语义角色，自适应学习从 MLLM 多层特征中聚合的权重，满足不同 token 对层级特征的差异化需求，为生成提供更精准的多模态引导。
summary.experiments: 论文在图像重建、文本到图像生成、指令驱动图像编辑三类任务上做了验证。与直接在语义空间做扩散的 RAE、VA-VAE 等基线相比，双流 tokenizer 在重建任务上显著降低了模糊与结构失真；自对齐范式在多项生成基准上达到与依赖外部教师的方法相当的结果；动态 token 路由相比固定层融合带来额外的指标增益。消融实验验证了非对称结构的必要性——如果语义流参与过多微调会出现理解能力下降，如果像素流容量不足则重建质量退化；同时验证了去掉外部教师后，自对齐方案随数据量扩大仍能保持稳定，没有出现明显的流形错配。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言部分对语义空间与像素空间矛盾的拆解，以及图 1 对现有方法缺陷的可视化，约 10 分钟可把握核心动机；接着看方法章节的双流 tokenizer 结构与自对齐范式的定义，重点理解非对称设计如何平衡理解与重建，约 15 分钟；最后浏览消融实验中关于双流容量配比、路由策略的对比，判断该设计的可迁移性，总阅读时间约 40 分钟。如果不做多模态生成基座，可只看 tokenizer 解耦思路与自对齐训练范式两部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Unified multimodal models perform maturely on visual understanding but cannot natively support image generation: the discriminative feature space of semantic encoders discards high-frequency textures and structural details, leading to blurriness and structural distortion when generation is performed directly in semantic space. Meanwhile, existing methods rely on external visual teachers such as DINOv2 for representation alignment, which suffers from manifold mismatch as data scale grows and fails to natively bridge understanding and generation in a unified space.
summary_en.importance: Three insights are relevant to pretraining research. First, the asymmetric dual-stream design of visual tokenizers provides a representation-layer solution for unified understanding-generation multimodal foundations, as it restores pixel reconstruction capability without breaking semantic discriminability. Second, the proposed self-alignment paradigm uses the same unified tokenizer as the alignment teacher for the generation stage, removing dependency on external feature models and reducing coupling in the training pipeline. Third, the dynamic token routing mechanism offers a lightweight way for multimodal tokens to aggregate multi-layer features on demand, which can transfer to other multimodal pretraining architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The SPAR framework has three components. First, an asymmetric dual-stream unified tokenizer: a lightweight semantic stream is frozen or lightly trained to preserve the encoder's original discriminative features, acting as an anchor to avoid catastrophic forgetting; a Transformer-augmented pixel stream maps high-dimensional semantic features into a compact latent space, specifically recovering high-frequency textures and structures discarded during the encoder's lossy compression. The two streams fuse in the same compact latent space, explicitly decoupling semantic preservation and pixel reconstruction. Second, a self-alignment generation paradigm: after training, the dual-stream tokenizer directly serves as the alignment teacher for the diffusion model, seamlessly transferring semantic and pixel knowledge to the generation stage without external standalone vision representation models. Third, Dynamic Token Routing (DTR): each token adaptively learns aggregation weights from multi-layer MLLM features according to its semantic role, satisfying differentiated hierarchical feature demands and providing more precise multimodal guidance for generation.
summary_en.experiments: Validation covers three task families: image reconstruction, text-to-image generation, and instruction-driven image editing. Compared with baselines that perform diffusion directly in semantic space, such as RAE and VA-VAE, the dual-stream tokenizer significantly reduces blurriness and structural distortion in reconstruction. The self-alignment paradigm achieves results comparable to external-teacher-based methods on multiple generation benchmarks. Dynamic token routing delivers additional metric gains over fixed-layer fusion. Ablations confirm the necessity of the asymmetric design: over-fine-tuning the semantic stream degrades understanding capability, while insufficient capacity in the pixel stream reduces reconstruction quality. They also show that the self-alignment scheme remains stable as data volume grows, with no obvious manifold mismatch after removing the external teacher.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction's breakdown of the contradiction between semantic and pixel spaces, plus Figure 1's visualization of existing methods' limitations — about 10 minutes to capture the core motivation. Then read the method section's dual-stream tokenizer structure and self-alignment paradigm definition, focusing on how the asymmetric design balances understanding and reconstruction — about 15 minutes. Finally browse ablation results on dual-stream capacity ratio and routing strategy to judge transferability, for a total of roughly 40 minutes. Readers not working on multimodal generation foundations can focus only on the tokenizer decoupling idea and the self-aligned training paradigm.

recommendation.zh: 非对称双流tokenizer的设计思路可用于多模态预训练的统一表示探索，重点看tokenizer结构与自对齐机制部分
recommendation.en: The asymmetric dual-stream tokenizer design is informative for unified multimodal pretraining; focus on the tokenizer architecture and self-alignment mechanism sections

paper.title: Language-Instructed Vision Embeddings for Controllable and Generalizable Perception
paper.abstract: Vision foundation models are typically trained as static feature extractors, placing the burden of task adaptation onto large downstream models. We propose an alternative paradigm: instead of solely feeding visual features into language models, we use language itself to dynamically guide the vision encoder. Our method, Language-Instructed Vision Embeddings (LIVE), leverages language as high-level guidance to produce task-centric embeddings at inference time, removing the need for task-specific r

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是传统 VLM 的“看图再交给大语言模型解释”，而是更前面的一步：能不能把语言指令直接注入视觉编码器，让视觉表征在推理时按任务动态变化。现有视觉基础模型大多输出静态 embedding，后续问“颜色”“类别”“关系”“是否异常”都只能依赖下游 LLM 在固定视觉特征上做二次推理。一旦视觉编码阶段没有保留某些细粒度信息，后面的 LLM 再大也补不回来，常见表现就是视觉幻觉和任务不受控。LIVE 的核心问题因此很明确：如何训练一个可被自然语言指令调制的视觉编码器，使其在零样本条件下直接产出面向当前任务的视觉 embedding，而不是把任务适配压力全部留给下游语言模型。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在两点。第一，它提出了一种“把语言知识蒸馏回视觉编码器”的路线，和主流“冻结视觉塔 + 扩大后端 LLM”形成了清楚对照。这对原生多模态预训练有启发，因为它讨论的是表示学习阶段的控制能力，而不是单纯靠更大的解码器兜底。第二，它把合成指令数据、对比式对齐目标、语言条件视觉编码三者连成了一个可操作 recipe，说明任务条件化表征可以在 encoder 侧学出来，并且能在不依赖大 LLM 推理的情况下改善泛化和幻觉。量级上，这不是通用 LLM 预训练范式的改写，但对 VLM 预训练、视觉 tokenizer/encoder 设计、以及“是否应把更多语义控制前移到感知层”这个问题，给出了比较扎实的实验支持。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，LIVE 延续了 CLIP/SigLIP 的双塔框架，但把视觉塔从静态编码器改成语言条件编码器。文本侧复用预训练文本编码器 T(·)，把指令 q 编成文本 embedding；视觉侧构造 E_live(x, T(q))，让图像编码过程显式依赖指令语义。训练目标不是生成答案，而是让“图像 + 指令”得到的视觉 embedding 对齐到正确答案的文本 embedding。也就是说，模型学的是一种任务定向的表征空间：给定同一张图，不同指令会把视觉表示拉向不同答案语义。

训练数据来自合成 triplet：图像、指令、答案。论文用 LLM 作为知识源，在 ImageNet 类图像上生成 instruction-response 对，再与图像组成训练样本。这个设计有两个关键点。其一，监督信号不是配对 caption，而是真正带任务意图的 instruction，因此比“图像描述对齐”更接近下游问答和感知控制。其二，答案仍落在文本编码器空间里，因此训练可以继续使用成熟的对比式对齐框架，而不必引入复杂生成头。

损失函数采用 SigLIP 风格的 sigmoid alignment loss，而不是 CLIP 常见的 softmax 对比损失。文中给出的理由是稳定性和效果更好，尤其适合批内正负样本匹配。训练时只优化语言条件视觉编码器，文本编码器作为语义锚点复用。推理时不需要大语言模型，只需输入图像和指令，就能得到任务相关 embedding，后续可直接用于分类、检索、问答匹配等。

从机制上看，这个方法和 Flamingo/LLaVA 一类架构的区别很清楚：后者把语言理解和任务适配主要放在大解码器里，视觉塔多半仍是通用静态特征提取器；LIVE 则把任务控制前移到视觉编码阶段。它也不同于 caption-conditioned 视觉调制工作，因为这里的文本不是描述图像内容，而是指定“该关注什么”。这使它更接近 instruction-following，而不是 image-text matching 的小改版。
summary.experiments:
实验结论比较集中，重点是“更小的系统，靠 encoder 侧任务化表征，能否替代 LLM-heavy 方案的一部分能力”。论文声称，LIVE 在 MMVP 上把视觉幻觉指标改善了 34 个点；在 GQA 上超过参数量大得多的 LLM-based 方法 7 个点，同时参数量不到对方的 10%。另一个值得注意的结果是，作者把 LIVE 与其作为知识源的 LLM 做 instruction-following 能力对比，称在若干指令跟随基准上把与知识源之间的差距最多缩小了 49 个点。这说明蒸馏并非只学到粗粒度类别信息，而是学到了一部分“按指令选择视觉证据”的能力。

从论文叙述看，实验不只做了最终任务分数，还包含注意力和检索可视化，用来证明视觉编码器内部确实出现了随指令变化的关注区域和表征迁移。这类分析对判断方法是否真的在 encoder 内形成 controllable perception 很关键，因为单看任务分数，仍可能怀疑收益来自数据偏置或答案空间约束。

消融方面，值得重点看三类：一是 instruction 数据相对 caption 数据的作用，验证“任务意图监督”是否真比描述性文本更有效；二是不同对齐损失和文本锚点设计对稳定性的影响；三是不同模型规模下，LIVE 相对 LLM-heavy 基线的参数效率。摘要里没有给出完整参数表和每个 benchmark 的细项数字，但从全文主结论看，作者想证明的不是绝对通用性，而是一个更省参数、更低推理成本的感知控制路径。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但方法部分值得认真看。建议先看 Introduction，重点抓住作者批评现有 VLM 的那条逻辑链：静态视觉特征会把任务适配压力推给后端 LLM，而后端无法恢复前端丢失的信息。接着看 Method 里 E_live(x, T(q)) 的定义和训练目标，确认它不是生成式 VQA，而是 answer-semantic alignment。这里要特别留意为什么答案端仍然放在文本 embedding 空间，以及为什么选 sigmoid loss。

实验部分建议优先看三类图表：MMVP/GQA 主结果表、与知识源 LLM 的 gap 分析、以及 attention/retrieval 可视化。前两者决定方法是否有实际收益，后者决定收益是否来自作者声称的机制。若时间有限，30 分钟左右可以抓住主线；若想深挖，建议继续看合成数据构造细节和消融，判断这种 recipe 是否能迁移到更大规模原生多模态预训练，或者是否受限于答案空间和 instruction 模板质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in current VLM pipelines: vision encoders are usually static, while task adaptation is deferred to a downstream LLM. That design is expensive and often brittle, because the LLM can only reason over whatever visual details the encoder preserved. If the encoder failed to represent the attribute or relation relevant to the query, scaling the decoder does not recover it. LIVE asks whether language instructions can directly steer the vision encoder at inference time, so that the encoder itself produces task-centric embeddings rather than generic visual features.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is not in replacing LLM pretraining, but in shifting where controllability is learned. The work argues that some of the semantic control usually handled by a large multimodal decoder can be moved into the representation-learning stage. That matters for native multimodal pretraining, because it suggests a different allocation of model capacity: less reliance on a heavy language backend, more task-aware perception in the encoder. It also provides a concrete recipe that combines synthetic instruction data, contrastive alignment, and language-conditioned visual encoding. For researchers thinking about multimodal pretraining objectives, encoder-side conditioning, or hallucination reduction through better representations rather than larger decoders, this is a useful signal.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LIVE starts from a CLIP/SigLIP-style dual-encoder setup, but replaces the static image encoder with a language-conditioned one. The text encoder T(.) is reused to encode an instruction q, and the vision encoder becomes E_live(x, T(q)), meaning the image representation is explicitly conditioned on the instruction embedding. The training target is not autoregressive answer generation. Instead, the instructed visual embedding is aligned to the text embedding of the correct answer. In effect, the model learns a task-dependent representation space: the same image can map to different embeddings depending on whether the instruction asks about category, color, relation, or some other attribute.

Training data is built as synthetic image-instruction-answer triplets. An LLM serves as the knowledge source to generate instruction-response pairs for images, and these are combined into supervision tuples. This is an important design choice. The text is not merely descriptive captioning; it encodes task intent. That makes the supervision closer to instruction following than standard image-text alignment. At the same time, because answers remain in the text-embedding space, the method can keep a simple contrastive-style alignment objective instead of adding a full generative head.

The loss follows the SigLIP-style sigmoid alignment objective rather than the standard CLIP softmax contrastive loss. The paper argues this gives better stability and performance for batchwise matching. The text encoder acts as a semantic anchor, while optimization focuses on the instruction-conditioned vision encoder. At inference time, no large LLM is needed: image plus instruction directly yields a task-relevant embedding that can support downstream matching or prediction.

The main distinction from LLaVA/Flamingo-like systems is where adaptation happens. Those systems mostly keep the vision tower generic and rely on a large decoder to integrate language and solve tasks. LIVE pushes task control into the encoder. It is also different from caption-conditioned visual modulation, because the conditioning text here specifies what to attend to, not just what is present in the image.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical message is that encoder-side instruction conditioning can recover part of the functionality usually delegated to much larger multimodal stacks. The paper reports a 34-point reduction in visual hallucination on MMVP. On GQA, LIVE is reported to outperform LLM-based counterparts by 7 points while using less than 10% of their parameters. Another notable result is the comparison to the LLM used as the knowledge source: on instruction-following benchmarks, LIVE reportedly narrows the gap to that teacher by up to 49 points. That suggests the model is not only learning coarse category cues, but some amount of instruction-dependent evidence selection.

The paper also includes attention and retrieval visualizations to support the mechanism claim. That matters, because task-level gains alone would not prove that controllable perception emerged inside the encoder; they could still come from answer-space bias or dataset artifacts. The visual analyses are intended to show that internal focus shifts with the instruction.

The most informative ablations are likely the ones comparing instruction supervision against caption-style supervision, different alignment losses, and parameter-efficiency trade-offs against LLM-heavy baselines. The abstract only exposes the headline numbers, but the full paper appears to position LIVE less as a universal VLM replacement and more as a parameter-efficient route to controllable perception.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the introduction first and check the central claim carefully: static visual features force downstream LLMs to compensate for information that may already be lost. Then move to the method section and focus on the definition of E_live(x, T(q)) and the answer-alignment objective. The key point is that this is not generative VQA; it is instruction-conditioned representation learning anchored in the text embedding space. Pay attention to why the answer is represented textually and why the sigmoid loss is preferred.

In the experiments, prioritize the main MMVP and GQA tables, the teacher-gap analysis, and the attention/retrieval visualizations. The first two tell you whether the method is practically useful; the last one tells you whether the claimed mechanism is plausible. If time is limited, about 30 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. If you want to go deeper, inspect the synthetic data construction and the ablations to judge whether the recipe could scale to larger native multimodal pretraining settings or whether it depends heavily on answer-space structure and instruction templates.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim：它挑战 frozen vision encoder 默认设置；重点看语言条件注入位置和 MMVP 消融是否干净。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming because it challenges the frozen-vision-encoder default; focus on where language conditioning enters and whether the MMVP ablations are clean.

paper.title: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Foundation models in language and multimodality achieve strong generalization by aligning heterogeneous data under a unified formulation and training at scale. In this report, we investigate whether this scaling recipe can be applied to robotic manipulation to achieve genuine generalization. This is challenging because, unlike text, manipulation data is heterogeneous by nature, expensive to collect, and narrow in diversity, making alignment and scale simultaneously difficult. We present Qwen-Rob

summary.core_problem: 机器人操作（manipulation）想复用“互联网多源数据对齐→规模化→涌现泛化”的 foundation model 路线，但操作数据天然异构（不同机器人形态、观测/动作空间不一致）、昂贵且分布窄。论文要解决的是：在跨 embodiment 的数据混训中，如何先把表示、动作与行为对齐到同一可学习接口，使得数据规模增加带来协同而不是干扰，并在此基础上验证是否出现随数据规模增长的泛化能力。
summary.importance:
对通用 LLM 预训练的直接相关性有限（更偏 VLA/机器人基础模型），但对“预训练数据对齐与 scaling”有两点可迁移启发：
1) 把 alignment 视为 scaling 的前置条件：当多源数据的坐标系/动作参数化不一致时，简单堆数据会产生梯度干扰，这个论点与多语种、多模态、多 tokenizer 体系的 pretrain 也相通；
2) 双流共训防止能力退化：在动作预测压力下保持 VLM backbone 的感知/推理能力，类似“任务数据 + 通用语料”混训以避免灾难性遗忘的 recipe。
但从筛选标准看，它主要贡献在机器人数据与评测设置，不是 LLM 基座预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法围绕“跨 embodiment 对齐”展开：
- Representation alignment：用共享的 canonical state-action 表示，并用按维度的 binary masking 兼容不同机器人形态（缺失的关节/末端执行器维度用 mask 处理）。
- Motion alignment：用 camera-frame 的 delta pose 参数化，让视觉上相似的运动在数值上更接近，减少坐标系差异带来的分布裂缝。
- Behavior alignment：用 system prompt + in-context policy adaptation，把同一 episode 的执行历史作为隐式 embodiment 标识，促使策略做运动学相关的自适应。
- Dual-stream co-training：同时在 manipulation 数据与 curated vision-language 流上训练，避免 VLM 主干在学动作时“变笨”。
- 数据规模化：human-to-robot synthesis 把第一视角手部演示转成 15 种平台的机器人轨迹；再做多源数据清洗/统一，累计约 38,100 小时。
这些设计更像“把异构监督信号对齐到统一 token/向量接口”的工程化系统方案，而不是提出新的语言建模目标。
summary.experiments:
片段信息显示其评测维度包括 instruction following、cross-embodiment transfer、in-distribution performance，以及 OOD 设置（如 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin-...）。但当前内容未给出可核验的具体成功率/提升幅度/模型规模曲线。
可确认的量化信息：训练数据规模约 38,100 小时，来源为开源机器人数据集 + 第一视角人类视频 + 合成数据；覆盖 15 种平台的人到机器人合成。
若要判断其“scaling law / emergent generalization”是否站得住，需要全文中的：1) 随数据量/模型量增长的对数线性或幂律拟合；2) 对齐模块的消融（去掉 motion/representation/behavior alignment 的退化幅度）；3) 双流共训 vs 只训操作数据的遗忘对比。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 alignment 的三块设计（representation/motion/behavior）各自解决什么不一致，以及它们是否真的让不同 embodiment 的动作在数值空间可比。
- 直接翻 scaling 曲线与消融表：有没有清晰证据表明“先对齐→再加数据”带来单调收益。
- 看 dual-stream co-training 的配比与训练动态：VLM 能力保持的指标是什么，是否出现负迁移。
- 如果主要兴趣是 LLM 预训练，可只读方法动机与对齐接口设计，跳过具体机器人 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Robotic manipulation wants to replicate the foundation-model scaling recipe (align heterogeneous data → scale training → generalization emerges), but manipulation data is inherently heterogeneous across embodiments and expensive, with narrow diversity. The paper addresses how to align representations, motions, and behaviors across different robots so that adding more data yields synergy rather than gradient interference, and then tests whether generalization improves with scale.
summary_en.importance:
Relevance to core LLM pretraining is indirect (this is primarily a VLA/robotics foundation model report), but it offers two transferable pretraining lessons:
- Alignment as a prerequisite for scaling: when sources are numerically incompatible (coordinate frames, action parameterizations), more data can hurt. This mirrors issues in multilingual/multimodal pretraining and multi-tokenizer setups.
- Dual-stream co-training to prevent capability erosion: mixing a general VLM stream with action prediction resembles anti-forgetting recipes in continual or multi-task pretraining.
Overall, the main contribution is in robotics data/benchmarking rather than new LM objectives or tokenizer theory for LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The system is built around cross-embodiment alignment:
- Representation alignment: a shared canonical state-action vector with per-dimension binary masks to accommodate different morphologies.
- Motion alignment: camera-frame delta-pose parameterization to make visually similar motions numerically close across coordinate frames.
- Behavior alignment: system prompts plus in-context policy adaptation, using within-episode execution history as an implicit embodiment identifier.
- Dual-stream co-training: jointly train on manipulation data and a curated vision-language stream to preserve perception/reasoning in the VLM backbone.
- Data scaling pipeline: human-to-robot synthesis converts egocentric hand demonstrations into robot trajectories across 15 platforms; multi-source curation yields ~38,100 hours from open datasets, egocentric videos, and synthetic data.
This is primarily an interface/alignment engineering solution rather than a new language modeling paradigm.
summary_en.experiments:
From the excerpt, evaluation axes include instruction following, cross-embodiment transfer, in-distribution performance, and OOD settings (e.g., LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin-*). However, the provided content does not include concrete success rates, deltas, or model/data scaling curves.
Hard numbers available here: ~38,100 hours of manipulation data; human-to-robot synthesis across 15 platforms.
To validate the “scaling law / emergent generalization” claim, the full paper needs to show: (1) performance vs data/model scale fits, (2) ablations removing each alignment component, and (3) evidence that dual-stream co-training mitigates forgetting/negative transfer.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the three alignment components (representation/motion/behavior) and check what incompatibility each resolves.
- Jump to scaling plots and ablation tables: does “alignment first, then scale” produce monotonic gains?
- Inspect the dual-stream co-training setup: mixture ratios, training dynamics, and the metrics used to claim VLM capability retention.
- If your focus is LLM pretraining, you can skip most robotics benchmark details and concentrate on the alignment interface design and scaling evidence.

recommendation.zh: 多模态三维度对齐解锁scaling的思路可迁移到异构预训练数据场景，重点看对齐框架的设计细节
recommendation.en: The 3-dimensional alignment framework for unlocking scaling with heterogeneous data is directly applicable to multimodal pretraining data pipelines; focus on the alignment design details.

paper.title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
paper.abstract: World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Cur

summary.core_problem: 现有世界模型无法同时满足Physical AI对多源异构数据原生学习、长时序持久状态保持、部署高效的三重核心需求
summary.importance: 范式创新+架构创新+数据方案贡献，首次提出面向Physical AI的原生世界模型全栈，覆盖预训练范式、数据课程与统一架构
summary.technical_approach: 1）提出原生预训练范式，搭配跨具身数据课程，按开放世界视频→人类行为数据→机器人交互数据的渐进路径组织训练；2）设计原生统一架构，采用混合线性时序注意力，用滑动窗口捕获局部动态、膨胀滑动窗口捕获中程依赖、门控线性注意力维持全局持久记忆
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据规模与量化对比结果，仅提及完成形式化验证与相关评测体系构建

summary_en.core_problem: Existing world models cannot simultaneously meet three core requirements of Physical AI: native learning from heterogeneous multi-source data, persistent long-horizon state maintenance, and deployment efficiency
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation + architecture innovation + data pipeline contribution, first proposing a full native world model stack for Physical AI covering pretraining paradigm, data curriculum, and unified architecture
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Proposes a native pretraining paradigm with a cross-embodiment data curriculum that organizes training data progressively as open-world videos → human behavior data → robot interactions; 2) Designs a unified architecture with hybrid linear temporal attention, using sliding windows for local dynamics, dilated sliding windows for mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention for persistent global memory
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; no specific model parameters, training data scale, or quantitative comparison results disclosed, only mentions formal verification and evaluation system construction

recommendation.zh: 跨具身渐进数据课程与混合时序注意力的组合设计改变了世界模型预训练数据组织的prior，应立刻在内部多模态预训练ablation中验证数据课程收益
recommendation.en: The combination of cross-embodiment progressive data curriculum and hybrid temporal attention shifts prior beliefs about world model pretraining data organization; validate curriculum gains in internal multimodal pretraining ablations immediately

paper.title: HYDRA-X: Native Unified Multimodal Models with Holistic Visual Tokenizers
paper.abstract: Holistic visual tokenizers are fundamental to unified multimodal models (UMMs) as they map diverse visual inputs into a unified representation space. In this paper, we present HYDRA-X, the first UMM that unifies image and video tokenization within a single Vision Transformer (ViT). Our design is driven by two core challenges: efficiently injecting spatiotemporal reconstruction capability into a native ViT, and embedding image- and video-level semantic awareness into the latent space. To address

summary.core_problem: 解决统一多模态模型里图像与视频 tokenizer 分裂的问题：如何用单一视觉 tokenizer 同时支持 image/video 的统一表示、重建与语义对齐。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把视觉 tokenizer 当作基座预训练问题来做，而不是把图像和视频分别离散化后再硬拼。对 native multimodal pretraining、统一 token space、以及 AR+非 AR 联合建模都很相关。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HYDRA-X，用单个 ViT 统一图像和视频 tokenization。技术上有两点：一是针对重建能力，作者发现 frame-level causal temporal attention 已足够，而全时空 attention 反而伤害重建；二是采用 hierarchical temporal compression，并配一个轻量 decompressor 在 joint image-video teacher supervision 下恢复时序细节，同时把图像级和视频级语义压进同一 latent space。整体目标是得到兼顾压缩、重建和语义一致性的 holistic visual tokenizer。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模和训练数据量，但强调做了系统 ablation，并给出两个较明确的经验结论：frame-level causal temporal attention 优于 full spatiotemporal attention；hierarchical temporal compression 优于 single-step compression。若正文实验干净，这些结论对视频 tokenizer 设计有直接参考价值。是否达到公开基准最优不是这里最重要的点，关键是 tokenizer 设计 prior 的修正。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a core bottleneck in unified multimodal models: image and video tokenization are usually split, so how can a single visual tokenizer support both modalities with shared representation, reconstruction, and semantics?
summary_en.importance: Its main value is treating the visual tokenizer itself as a foundation-model pretraining problem rather than stitching together separate image and video tokenizers. This is directly relevant to native multimodal pretraining, unified token spaces, and AR/non-AR joint modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: HYDRA-X proposes a single-ViT tokenizer for both images and videos. Two technical findings drive the design: for reconstruction, frame-level causal temporal attention is sufficient, while full spatiotemporal attention actually hurts; and hierarchical temporal compression works better than single-step compression. A lightweight decompressor, trained with joint image-video teacher supervision, restores temporally compressed features and injects complementary semantic structure into a shared latent space.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full model sizes or dataset scale, but it emphasizes systematic ablations and two concrete empirical conclusions: frame-level causal temporal attention beats full spatiotemporal attention for reconstruction, and hierarchical temporal compression beats single-step compression. If the full setup is clean, these are directly useful priors for video tokenizer design. Whether it tops public benchmarks is less important than the tokenizer-design correction it suggests.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是 tokenizer ablation，不是“统一多模态”口号；重点读 temporal attention 和 compression 两组实验，可能直接改你的视频 token 设计。
recommendation.en: Read it for the tokenizer ablations, not the branding around unified multimodality; the temporal-attention and compression studies may directly change how you design video tokens.

paper.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
paper.abstract: This work presents RepWAM, a representation-centric world action model (WAM) built on representation visual-action tokenizers. Existing WAMs typically inherit reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers from pretrained video generation models. Although these tokenizers preserve visual fidelity, pixel reconstruction alone provides limited guidance for learning instruction-following dynamics that connect future prediction with robot control. To address this, we explore a semantic visual-action latent

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个能更好地将未来预测与机器人控制联系起来的、基于表示的世界动作模型（WAM）？
summary.importance: 指出现有基于重建的视频tokenizer在学习指令跟随动态（连接预测与控制）方面存在局限，提出了一种基于语义视觉-动作潜在空间的表示中心WAM。
summary.technical_approach: 训练一个表示视觉-动作tokenizer，将视觉输入映射到对齐的视觉和潜在动作token。然后预训练WAM，在语言指令下联合建模未来视觉状态和连接它们的潜在动作，最后适应真实机器人轨迹进行闭环操作。
summary.experiments: 在真实世界操作任务和模拟基准测试中进行了实验，表明RepWAM提供了更好的性能（具体提升幅度未在摘要中说明）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自复旦大学、蚂蚁集团等，Yu-Gang Jiang是复旦大学知名教授，Yujun Shen在生成模型领域有丰富经验。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a representation-centric World Action Model (WAM) that better connects future prediction with robot control?
summary_en.importance: Identifies limitations of existing reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers in learning instruction-following dynamics (connecting prediction and control), and proposes a representation-centric WAM based on a semantic visual-action latent space.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a representation visual-action tokenizer mapping visual inputs to aligned visual and latent action tokens. Pretrains the WAM to jointly model future visual states and connecting latent actions under language instructions, followed by adaptation to real robot trajectories for closed-loop manipulation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks show RepWAM delivers better performance (specific improvements not detailed in abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Fudan University, Ant Group, etc. Yu-Gang Jiang is a well-known professor at Fudan, and Yujun Shen has extensive experience in generative models.

recommendation.zh: 探索了视觉-动作联合 tokenizer 的设计，对多模态统一预训练中如何离散化和对齐控制信号有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Explores the design of a joint visual-action tokenizer, offering reference value for discretizing and aligning control signals in unified multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: AdaTok: Self-Budgeting Image Tokenization with Quality-Preserving Dynamic Tokens
paper.abstract: Image tokenizers, from 2D grids to recent 1D sequences, typically encode every image with the same fixed number of tokens. Yet visual complexity is highly heterogeneous, so a uniform budget overspends on simple inputs and underserves complex ones. Existing elastic tokenizers expose variable-length reconstructions, but often leave token length as a deployment-time operating point, a search target, or an external prediction rather than an output of the tokenizer itself. In this work, we ask whethe

summary.core_problem: 现有离散图像tokenizer普遍采用固定token数编码所有图像，无法适配不同图像的视觉复杂度差异，且弹性tokenizer的长度需外部控制而非tokenizer内生输出，存在资源错配问题
summary.importance: 方法创新+范式改进，首次实现单步自预算的离散图像tokenizer，解决了固定token预算的资源浪费与表达不足的矛盾，属于多模态统一预训练核心组件的重要创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出AdaTok自预算离散1D tokenizer，采用表示-分配协同设计：1）优先表示学习，通过嵌套尾掩码对token按语义优先级排序，用多头LoRA解码器解决不同预算下的语义偏移问题；2）内生自预算机制，tokenizer可在一次前向中自动确定每个图像的最优token数
summary.experiments: 提供的摘要未完整披露实验设置与对比结果，核心验证方向为不同复杂度图像的重建质量与token预算效率的平衡
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自香港理工大学等高校，暂无广泛知名的LLM基座预训练相关代表性工作

summary_en.core_problem: Existing discrete image tokenizers encode all images with a fixed number of tokens, failing to adapt to varying visual complexity; elastic tokenizers require external control of token length instead of endogenous output, leading to resource misallocation
summary_en.importance: Method innovation + paradigm improvement, the first one-pass self-budgeting discrete image tokenizer, resolving the contradiction between resource waste and insufficient expressiveness of fixed token budgets, an important innovation for core unified multimodal pretraining components
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose AdaTok, a self-budgeting discrete 1D tokenizer with representation-allocation co-design: 1) Prioritized Representation Learning ordering tokens by semantic priority via nested tail masking, resolving budget-dependent semantic shift with Multi-Head LoRA decoder; 2) Endogenous self-budget mechanism allowing the tokenizer to determine optimal token count per image in one forward pass
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not fully disclose experimental setup and comparative results. Core validation focuses on balancing reconstruction quality and token budget efficiency for images of different complexity
summary_en.authors_note: The author team is from universities including Hong Kong Polytechnic University, with no widely known representative work in LLM base pretraining

recommendation.zh: 做多模态统一预训练的研究员必读其方法部分，自预算和嵌套尾掩码设计可直接引入视觉tokenizer的内部消融
recommendation.en: Multimodal pretrain researchers should read its method section; the self-budgeting and nested tail masking designs can be directly used in internal visual tokenizer ablations

paper.title: Adaptive Tokenisation Via Temporal Redundancy Masking And Latent Inpainting
paper.abstract: Adaptive video tokenisation seeks to dynamically allocate token budgets based on the underlying visual complexity of a sequence. Current continuous-regime approaches achieve this via iterative binarised searches or trained neural regressors, while discrete methods often require a full-rate decoder pass to estimate information content. We demonstrate that such computational overheads are not strictly necessary. We show that the latent space of a frozen continuous video tokeniser inherently encode

summary.core_problem: 为视频 tokenization 动态分配 token 预算，避免静态场景和高动态场景使用同样数量的视觉 token。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频 token 压缩和自适应视觉表示，不是 LLM 预训练方法本身，但对原生多模态模型的视觉 token budget、长视频上下文和训练吞吐有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法利用冻结连续视频 tokenizer 的 latent 空间，计算相邻帧同一空间位置的 temporal-L1 差异。差异低于固定阈值的位置被视为时间冗余并丢弃，压缩率由输入内容自然决定。被丢弃位置通过 latent inpainting 恢复，而不是先完整解码再估计信息量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体 tokenizer、数据集、压缩率和质量指标。核心比较对象应包括需要迭代二分搜索、训练回归器或完整 decoder pass 的自适应 token 分配方法；静态场景应产生更高压缩率，动态场景保留更多 token。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses adaptive video tokenization: allocating token budgets according to visual complexity instead of using a fixed token count for all sequences.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in video token compression and adaptive visual representation. It is not an LLM pretraining method, but it is relevant to token budgets, long-video context, and throughput in native multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: It uses the latent space of a frozen continuous video tokenizer and computes temporal L1 differences at matching spatial positions across consecutive frames. Positions with changes below a fixed threshold are treated as temporally redundant and dropped, letting the compression rate emerge from the input. Dropped positions are recovered via latent inpainting rather than a full decoder pass.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the tokenizer, datasets, compression ratios, or quality numbers. The key baselines are adaptive token allocation methods that require iterative search, trained regressors, or full-rate decoder passes; static scenes should compress more aggressively while dynamic scenes retain more tokens.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和压缩-质量曲线；若在做视频 tokenizer 或多模态长上下文，这个零参数启发可顺手复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method figure and compression-quality curves only; the zero-parameter heuristic is worth trying if you build video tokenizers or long-context VLMs.

paper.title: Audio Interaction Model
paper.abstract: Audio is an inherently interactive modality, yet today's Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) are offline, and streaming audio models each handle only a single task such as streaming ASR or voice chatting. It is time to unify them into one online LALM: a model that, through an always-on perceive-decide-respond loop, listens to sound, environment, and instructions in real time and reacts on the fly. We formalize this regime as the Audio Interaction Model, and realize it with Audio-Interaction, a u

summary.core_problem: 解决大音频模型长期停留在离线处理或单一流式任务的问题，构建一个可持续监听、决策并实时响应的统一在线音频交互模型。
summary.importance: 这项工作的重要性不在单个语音任务指标，而在于把“音频作为持续交互流”来建模，提出了从数据构造、训练目标到低时延部署的一体化范式。对做语音/音频 LM、统一多模态预训练和在线 agent loop 的研究员都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文形式化提出 Audio Interaction Model，并用 Audio-Interaction 实现。核心框架 SoundFlow 把系统拆成 perceive-decide-respond 闭环：一是构造 streaming-native 数据，使模型在前缀可见条件下学习何时理解、何时等待、何时响应；二是做 comprehension-aware training，让模型不仅生成内容，还学习基于流式语义决定响应时机；三是采用异步低延迟推理与部署机制，保证实时交互稳定性，同时保留离线任务能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其覆盖在线一般音频指令跟随、对话和完整语音聊天，并强调在保留离线任务执行能力的同时加入在线交互能力。当前公开摘要未给出明确参数量、训练 token、具体 baseline 和量化提升幅度，因此更适合先看任务定义、数据构造和系统设计，再判断实验结论的外推性。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单含 Shuicheng Yan，团队看起来接近产业研究机构与学术合作，方向上与近年统一音频-语言建模、实时语音交互系统一脉相承。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the gap that current large audio-language models are mostly offline, while streaming models are usually single-task, by building a unified online model that continuously listens, decides, and responds in real time.
summary_en.importance: The value is less about a single speech benchmark and more about reframing audio as an always-on interactive stream. It contributes a full-stack recipe spanning data construction, training objective, and low-latency deployment, which is relevant to audio LM, unified multimodal pretraining, and online agent-style modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes the Audio Interaction Model and instantiates it as Audio-Interaction. Its SoundFlow framework implements an end-to-end perceive-decide-respond loop: streaming-native data construction teaches prefix-only interaction; comprehension-aware training teaches not only what to say but when to respond based on streaming semantics; asynchronous low-latency inference supports stable real-time interaction while preserving offline task capability.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the model is evaluated on online general audio instruction following, dialogue, and full voice chat, while retaining offline task performance. The abstract does not expose model size, training data scale, baselines, or exact gains, so the main reading value is currently in the problem formulation, data pipeline, and system design rather than headline numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Shuicheng Yan, suggesting a team with strong industry-research flavor. The work sits in the line of recent unified audio-language modeling and real-time speech interaction systems.

recommendation.zh: 把语音从“离线理解”改成“持续交互流”这个 framing 值得看；先读数据与何时响应的训练设计，若实验只堆系统工程则别高估其范式意义。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the reframing of speech as a continuous interaction stream; read the data and response-timing training design first, and do not over-credit it if the gains mostly come from systems glue.

paper.title: AdaCodec: A Predictive Visual Code for Video MLLMs

summary.core_problem: AdaCodec 解决的是视频 MLLM 的视觉接口低效问题。现有模型通常把视频采样成一组 RGB 帧，再把每帧独立编码成视觉 token。相邻帧中大量背景、物体和布局是重复的，导致 token 数随帧数近似线性增长，并在长视频场景下形成覆盖范围、细节密度和延迟之间的冲突。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对多模态预训练和 native multimodal LM 有较强参考价值。它没有只做 frame selection 或 token pruning，而是重新定义视频进入 LLM 的表示形式：参考帧给完整视觉 token，可预测的中间帧只传 motion 和 residual。这个方向更接近“为语言模型设计视觉 tokenizer/codec”，而不是在固定视觉编码器后面做压缩。对长视频预训练而言，关键启发是把时间冗余消除前移到 tokenizer/visual code 层，从而减少上下文占用和首 token 延迟。
summary.technical_approach: AdaCodec 借鉴预测编码。视频被划分为 GOP，每个 GOP 的首帧作为 I-frame，用常规 ViT 视觉 token 表示；后续 P-frame 不再作为完整 RGB 图像输入，而是相对前一采样帧表示为运动向量和预测残差。系统会计算 conditional predictive cost，简称 pcost。当当前帧难以由过去上下文预测时，模型重置并插入新的参考帧；当预测代价较低时，只输入紧凑 P-token。架构上采用双分支视觉 token pipeline：一支处理完整参考帧 token，另一支处理 motion/residual 形成的 P-frame token，最后交给 LLM 处理交错序列。训练上使用两阶段流程：先学习 P-frame 表示，使其能承载时序变化信息；再做多模态对齐，让已有 video MLLM 能消费这种预测式视觉码。与传统视频 codec 的区别是，目标不是重建人眼可观看的 bitstream，而是为 LLM 推理保留足够证据，同时减少冗余视觉 token。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 11 个视频 benchmark。论文报告，在 224k visual-token 预算下，AdaCodec 在比较的开源模型中，在 3 个长视频 benchmark 全部取得最高结果，并在 3 个 temporal benchmark 中的 2 个上表现最好。在更紧的预算下，32k visual-token 的 AdaCodec 已经超过 224k visual-token 的 Qwen3-VL-8B baseline，且这一结论在所有长视频 benchmark 上成立。在 5 个通用视频理解 benchmark 上，AdaCodec 减少 84.7% 的视觉 token，time-to-first-token 从 9.26 秒降到 1.62 秒，同时平均分数提升。消融实验据称验证了预测式 code、P-frame tokenizer 和 pcost reset 等组件的作用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 30–45 分钟。优先看 Figure 2 和 Table 1：它们说明 AdaCodec 与标准视频 codec、逐帧 RGB 接口的差异。Method 中重点关注三点：pcost 如何决定参考帧重置；motion/residual 如何转成 P-token；两阶段训练如何把预测码对齐到 LLM。实验部分重点看 token budget 对比、long-video benchmark 表格、TTFT 延迟统计和组件消融。对预训练研究员来说，最值得深挖的是这种 visual code 能否成为视频-语言联合预训练阶段的原生 tokenizer，而不只是推理侧压缩模块。

summary_en.core_problem: AdaCodec addresses the inefficiency of the visual interface in video MLLMs. Most current systems sample a video into RGB frames and encode each frame independently. Adjacent frames contain repeated objects, background, and layout, so the visual-token cost grows roughly linearly with the number of sampled frames. This creates a coverage-detail-latency trade-off for long-video understanding.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to multimodal pretraining because it changes the representation that enters the language model. It is not merely frame selection or token pruning after a fixed encoder. It proposes a predictive visual code: full tokens are spent on reference frames, while predictable intermediate frames are represented by motion and residual cues. This is closer to designing a video tokenizer for MLLMs. The main lesson for long-video pretraining is that temporal redundancy should be removed before tokens enter the LLM context, rather than handled only by long-context attention or memory modules.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaCodec adapts predictive coding to video MLLMs. A video is divided into GOPs. The first frame in each GOP is an I-frame and is encoded with full ViT-style visual tokens. Later frames are P-frames and are represented relative to the preceding sampled frame through motion vectors and residual signals. A conditional predictive cost, called pcost, decides when prediction is no longer reliable; high pcost triggers a reset and inserts a new reference frame. The model uses a dual-branch visual-token pipeline: one branch processes full reference-frame tokens, and another turns motion/residual information into compact P-tokens. The LLM receives an interleaved sequence of I-frame tokens and P-tokens. Training is done in two stages: first learning P-frame representations, then aligning the predictive code with the multimodal language model. Unlike a playback-oriented video codec, the objective is not standards-compliant reconstruction for human viewing, but preserving reasoning evidence while reducing redundant visual tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on eleven video benchmarks. Under a matched 224k visual-token budget, AdaCodec reports the best open-source results in its comparison on all three long-video benchmarks and on two of three temporal benchmarks. Under a tighter budget, AdaCodec with 32k visual tokens already surpasses the 224k-token Qwen3-VL-8B baseline on all long-video benchmarks. On five general video-understanding benchmarks, it reduces visual tokens by 84.7%, lowers time-to-first-token from 9.26 seconds to 1.62 seconds, and improves the average score. The ablations are reported to support the roles of the predictive code, the P-frame tokenizer, and pcost-driven resets.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim to semi-deep read in 30–45 minutes. Start with Figure 2 and Table 1, which clarify how AdaCodec differs from a standard video codec and from per-frame RGB encoding. In the method, focus on how pcost triggers reference-frame resets, how motion and residual signals become P-tokens, and how the two-stage alignment pipeline connects the code to an existing MLLM. In the experiments, read the token-budget comparisons, long-video tables, time-to-first-token measurements, and component ablations. For pretraining researchers, the most useful question is whether this predictive visual code can serve as a native tokenizer for video-language pretraining, rather than only as an inference-time compression interface.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 unified LM 的视觉 token 预算，这篇值得扫；重点看它是否真利用时序可预测性做“新信息编码”，而不是换个名字做更强压缩器。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming if you care about visual token budget in unified LMs; the key question is whether it truly encodes temporal novelty rather than just being a better compressor with a new name.

paper.title: Zamba2-VL Technical Report

summary.core_problem: 这篇技术报告要回答的问题很直接：在开放权重 VLM 里，能不能把混合 SSM-Transformer 语言骨干真正做成一条可用路线，而不是只停留在“更快但效果差一些”的替代品。更具体地说，它针对两类长期矛盾：一是 Transformer VLM 在高分辨率图像、长视觉序列、视频场景下，prefill 和 KV cache 成本增长太快；二是纯 Mamba/SSM VLM 虽然推理便宜，但在 grounding、细粒度检索、依赖精确上下文读取的任务上往往掉点。Zamba2-VL 试图用 Zamba2 的混合骨干把这两个问题一起处理：让大部分序列建模走线性时间的 Mamba2 路径，只保留少量共享 Transformer block 负责内容寻址和精确检索。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的意义主要不在“又一个 VLM 分数表”，而在于它给出了一种更清楚的架构信号：如果目标是原生支持长视觉上下文，单纯做视觉 token 压缩并不够，语言骨干本身的序列复杂度也要改。Zamba2-VL 的价值在于，它不是把现成 Transformer VLM 蒸馏到 SSM 上，而是直接建立在已经较成熟的混合 LLM 骨干之上，验证这种骨干在多模态里仍然成立。对预训练侧的启发有三点。第一，SSM 与少量 attention 的混合可能比纯 attention 或纯 SSM 更适合多模态，因为视觉任务既需要长序列吞吐，也需要局部精确读取。第二，VLM 的系统效率不能只看 decode throughput，TTFT 和 prefill 才是高分辨率输入下更硬的瓶颈。第三，这类工作把“骨干选择”重新带回 VLM 训练设计，而不是默认语言侧只能继承 Transformer。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上延续了标准 LLaVA 式配方，但关键变化在语言骨干。整体结构是：预训练视觉编码器提取图像特征，经由轻量 connector 映射到语言模型输入空间，再与文本 token 一起送入 Zamba2 骨干。Zamba2 本身不是纯 Mamba2，而是以 Mamba2 层承担主体计算，并插入少量共享 Transformer block；这些共享 attention block 在不同深度通过轻量 LoRA 投影做位置特化。这样做的理由很明确：Mamba2 负责线性时间序列处理和常数状态解码，Transformer block 负责内容寻址能力，弥补纯 SSM 在 in-context retrieval 上的短板。

从报告给出的叙述看，Zamba2-VL 重点不是提出新的视觉 tokenizer 或复杂跨模态对齐损失，而是尽量控制变量，把“骨干替换”这件事单独做扎实。它沿用当前主流开源 VLM 的视觉-语言连接范式，因此性能差异更容易归因到 backbone，而不是训练 recipe 的大幅变化。报告还强调其效率收益来自骨干复杂度本身，而不是输入侧 token pruning、merge 或 native token reduction。这一点很重要，因为它说明作者想证明的是：即便视觉 token 数不变，只要把语言骨干从全 attention 改成 hybrid SSM-attention，prefill 和生成状态管理就会出现结构性改善。

如果从预训练研究角度看，真正值得注意的是 shared Transformer blocks 的设计。它不是在每层都保留 attention，而是把 attention 当作稀缺资源，只在少数位置提供全局内容寻址，再用 LoRA 做层位适配。这种做法隐含一个判断：多模态建模里，attention 的价值更像“关键功能模块”，而不是必须均匀铺满全网的默认算子。
summary.experiments:
报告覆盖 1.2B、2.7B、7B 三个尺度的 Zamba2-VL。按作者描述，在图像理解、OCR、reasoning、grounding、counting 等一组通用 benchmark 上，它与同尺度开放权重 Transformer VLM，如 Molmo2、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5，处于可竞争区间；同时明显强于此前的 SSM 或混合 VLM，如 VL-Mamba、Cobra、mmMamba。效率侧是最核心结果：依托 Zamba2 骨干的近线性 prefill 和近常数 recurrent state，Zamba2-VL 在 matched parameter scale 下的 time-to-first-token 大约比这些 Transformer 基线低一个数量级。

从全文可提炼出的实验重点有两个。第一，作者并不只比较最终任务分数，而是把系统指标单独拿出来，强调高分辨率视觉输入下 TTFT 的差异。这比只报 token/s 更贴近真实 VLM 部署。第二，比较对象覆盖了纯 Transformer、纯 SSM、以及已有 hybrid/蒸馏路线，因此能看出 Zamba2-VL 的定位不是“最快但精度退让”，而是试图把精度拉回主流开源 VLM 水平。

不过从已给出的内容看，这篇报告更像系统性技术展示，而不是细粒度机制论文。若要严谨评估，还需要重点核对几类信息：训练数据规模是否与对手严格匹配；视觉编码器与 connector 是否完全同级；长上下文和视频场景下的吞吐、显存、TTFT 曲线是否覆盖不同 batch/分辨率；以及 grounding/检索类任务上 hybrid 相比 pure SSM 的增益幅度有多稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议带着“骨干替换是否真的带来结构性收益”这个问题去看。先看 Introduction，作者把问题定义得比较清楚：不是再做一个 connector 小改，而是讨论 VLM 为什么需要不同于 Transformer-only 的语言骨干。然后重点看架构图和 backbone 说明，尤其是 shared Transformer blocks 如何插入 Mamba2 主干、LoRA specialization 怎么做。实验部分优先看三类表：一类是通用多模态 benchmark，确认它是否真的回到主流 Transformer VLM 的性能带；一类是 TTFT/prefill/decoding 指标，判断效率收益来自哪里；一类是与 VL-Mamba、Cobra、mmMamba 的对比，理解 hybrid 相比 pure SSM 或蒸馏路线的差异。

如果时间有限，30 到 45 分钟足够抓住主线。真正值得深挖的点有两个：一是 attention 在 hybrid 骨干里到底需要多稀疏，才能保住 grounding 和 OCR；二是这种骨干在预训练阶段是否会改变最优数据配比、序列长度 curriculum 和优化超参。报告本身未必完全回答，但会给出后续实验方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The report tackles a concrete question: can a hybrid SSM-Transformer backbone become a practical VLM backbone, rather than a faster-but-weaker alternative to Transformer VLMs. The tension is twofold. Transformer VLMs become expensive quickly under high-resolution images, long visual sequences, and video because prefill cost and KV cache scale poorly. Pure Mamba/SSM VLMs improve efficiency, but often lose accuracy on tasks that require precise in-context lookup, such as grounding, referring expressions, and fine-grained retrieval. Zamba2-VL is designed to address both sides at once: let Mamba2 handle most sequence processing in linear time, while keeping a small number of Transformer blocks for content-addressable retrieval.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is not another benchmark table. The stronger signal is architectural. If the target is native support for long visual contexts, input-side token compression alone is not enough; the language backbone itself must change its scaling behavior. Zamba2-VL matters because it is not merely distilling a Transformer VLM into an SSM model. It starts from a relatively mature hybrid LLM backbone and shows that the same design transfers to multimodal modeling. There are three useful takeaways. First, multimodal modeling may prefer hybrid SSM-plus-attention backbones over either pure attention or pure SSM, because visual workloads need both long-sequence efficiency and exact retrieval. Second, VLM efficiency should not be judged only by decode throughput; TTFT and prefill are often the harder bottlenecks for high-resolution inputs. Third, it reopens backbone choice as a first-class VLM design variable instead of assuming that the language side must remain Transformer-only.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The overall recipe stays close to the standard LLaVA-style pipeline, but the language backbone is replaced. A pretrained vision encoder extracts image features, a lightweight connector maps them into the LM input space, and the resulting visual tokens are processed jointly with text tokens by Zamba2. Zamba2 itself is not a pure Mamba2 model. Most layers are Mamba2 state-space layers, while a small number of shared Transformer blocks are inserted throughout the network. These shared attention blocks are lightly specialized at different insertion points through LoRA projections. The rationale is straightforward: Mamba2 provides linear-time sequence processing and constant-state decoding, while the Transformer blocks restore the content-addressable behavior that pure SSMs tend to lack.

A notable aspect of the report is what it does not try to change. It does not center the contribution on a new visual tokenizer, a new alignment loss, or a heavily modified multimodal recipe. Instead, it keeps the multimodal interface relatively standard so that the main variable is the backbone. That makes the comparison more interpretable. The claimed efficiency gain comes from the backbone’s computational structure rather than from token pruning, token merging, or native token reduction on the vision side. In other words, even with similar visual token counts, replacing a full-attention LM with a hybrid SSM-attention LM changes prefill and decoding-state behavior in a structural way.

From a pretraining perspective, the most interesting design choice is the use of shared Transformer blocks as a sparse resource rather than a default operator in every layer. This suggests a specific hypothesis: in multimodal models, attention may be most valuable as a targeted retrieval mechanism, not as the uniform backbone everywhere.
summary_en.experiments:
The report covers 1.2B, 2.7B, and 7B Zamba2-VL models. According to the full text, the models are competitive with open-weight Transformer VLMs of similar scale, including Molmo2, Qwen3-VL, and InternVL3.5, across image understanding, OCR, reasoning, grounding, and counting benchmarks. At the same time, they substantially outperform earlier SSM-based or hybrid VLMs such as VL-Mamba, Cobra, and mmMamba. The key systems result is efficiency: thanks to near-linear prefill and a small near-constant recurrent state inherited from Zamba2, Zamba2-VL reports roughly an order-of-magnitude lower time-to-first-token than matched Transformer baselines.

Two experimental themes matter most. First, the report explicitly separates task accuracy from systems metrics, especially TTFT under high-resolution visual inputs. That is more informative than reporting only tokens per second. Second, the comparison spans pure Transformer, pure SSM, and prior hybrid or distillation-based VLMs, so the positioning is clear: the goal is not merely to be the fastest model, but to recover mainstream open VLM quality while keeping the efficiency profile of SSM-style backbones.

That said, this is more of a technical report than a mechanism-heavy paper. A careful reader should still verify several details in the full experimental section: whether training data scale is tightly matched against baselines, whether the vision encoder and connector are comparable, how TTFT and memory scale across resolution and batch size, and how stable the hybrid advantage is on retrieval-heavy tasks where pure SSMs usually struggle.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading with one question in mind: does changing the backbone create a structural gain, or only a benchmark-specific tradeoff. Start with the introduction, which frames the problem well: the point is not another connector tweak, but why VLMs may need a different language backbone from Transformer-only models. Then look at the architecture figure and the backbone description, especially how shared Transformer blocks are inserted into the Mamba2 trunk and how LoRA specialization is used. In the experiments, prioritize three groups of results: general multimodal benchmarks to see whether quality returns to the mainstream Transformer VLM range; TTFT/prefill/decoding metrics to understand where efficiency comes from; and comparisons against VL-Mamba, Cobra, and mmMamba to isolate the benefit of the hybrid route over pure SSM or distillation-based approaches.

If time is limited, 30 to 45 minutes should be enough. The deeper questions worth following up are: how sparse attention can become before grounding and OCR degrade, and whether this backbone changes optimal pretraining choices such as data mixture, sequence-length curriculum, or optimization settings.

recommendation.zh: 先只看训练阶段划分、数据配比和连接器设计那几页：如果细节够“可抄”，就值回票价；否则当营销稿处理。
recommendation.en: Skim only the pages on training stages, data mixture, and the vision-LLM connector—if it’s copyable it’s useful; if not, treat it as a marketing report.

paper.title: On the Limits of Token Reduction for Efficient Unified Vision Language Training

summary.core_problem: 系统研究token reduction技术在统一视觉语言训练中的效率-性能trade-off与极限。
summary.importance: 原理分析类工作，揭示VLM训练中视觉token压缩策略的适用边界与隐性代价。
summary.technical_approach: 在VLM预训练和微调各阶段评估不同token reduction策略（如采样、聚类、注意力裁剪）对性能和效率的影响。
summary.experiments: 未提供摘要，实验设置与结果未知。

summary_en.core_problem: Systematically studies the efficiency-performance trade-offs and limits of token reduction techniques in unified vision-language training.
summary_en.importance: Analysis work revealing the适用边界 and hidden costs of visual token compression in VLM training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Evaluates various token reduction strategies (sampling, clustering, attention pruning) at pretraining and fine-tuning stages of VLM on both performance and efficiency axes.
summary_en.experiments: No abstract provided; experimental setup and results unknown.

recommendation.zh: VLM训练token reduction上限分析，对多模态预训练效率策略有参考，建议扫读实验图表即可。
recommendation.en: Token reduction limit analysis in VLM training; useful reference for multimodal pretraining efficiency strategy, suggest glancing at experiment figures only.

paper.title: UniAudio-Token: Empowering Semantic Speech Tokenizers with General Audio Perception
paper.abstract: Semantic speech tokenizers have become a widely used interface for Audio-LLMs, owing to their compact single-codebook design and strong linguistic alignment. However, their focus on linguistic abstraction induces acoustic blindness, limiting their applicability beyond speech-centric tasks. We propose UniAudio-Token, a framework that empowers semantic tokenizers with general audio perception without compromising speech ability. Instead of altering the semantic paradigm, UniAudio-Token mitigates i

summary.core_problem: 语义语音 tokenizer（如基于 ASR 编码器的单码本 tokenizer）在 Audio-LLM 中被广泛采用，但其为语言学内容优化的深层编码器会主动抑制人声线索和听觉场景细节，导致"声学盲"（acoustic blindness），限制了其在语音之外的通用音频感知能力。现有方案被迫采用异构架构（分别使用离散 tokenizer 做语音生成、外部连续编码器做通用音频理解），未能在单个码本中统一支持高保真语音生成和高层通用音频理解。
summary.importance: 对 Audio-LLM 统一建模范式有直接参考价值。揭示了语义语音 tokenizer 作为 Audio-LLM 前端的根本性表征瓶颈，并提出了监督层面和架构层面的双重解耦机制。如果通用音频 tokenizer 能同时保留语义对齐和声学细节，将简化 Audio-LLM 的多任务统一建模。
summary.technical_approach: UniAudio-Token 框架包含两个核心创新：(1) 语义-声学基元（Semantic-Acoustic Primitives, SAP）：由 LLM 生成结构化监督协议，将原始音频分解为语言内容、人声属性和听觉场景基元，在监督层面解耦内容与风格，迫使模型为声学细节分配容量；(2) 语义-声平衡（Semantic-Acoustic Equilibrium, SAE）：内容感知门控机制，在需要时自适应地将浅层的细粒度声学细节注入深层语义流，在不破坏语义表征的前提下缓解声学盲。框架保留单码本设计，可直接接入标准 LLM 架构。
summary.experiments: 在 tokenizer 层面，UniAudio-Token 在 ESC 数据集上实现了高聚类纯度（Cluster Purity），能为各类音频事件形成清晰聚类，而基线模型难以做到；通用音频感知能力的获得未损害语音生成能力，反而在生成质量上超过了专用语音 tokenizer。在 Audio-LLM 层面，将此前端接入 Qwen2.5 后在理解和生成任务上均取得更优性能。消融实验验证了 SAE 机制的自适应行为。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 章方法部分，理解 SAP 如何由 LLM 生成结构化监督、SAE 门控的具体实现；第 4 章实验中的 ESC 聚类纯度分析和 Audio-LLM 端到端对比。预计阅读时间 30-40 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 论文未在提供内容中明确列出机构和作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Semantic speech tokenizers (e.g., ASR-encoder-based single-codebook tokenizers) are widely adopted in Audio-LLMs, but their deep encoders optimized for linguistic content actively suppress vocal cues and auditory scene details, causing 'acoustic blindness' that limits their ability to handle general audio beyond speech. Existing solutions resort to heterogeneous architectures (separate discrete tokenizer for speech generation and external continuous encoders for general audio understanding), failing to unify high-fidelity speech generation and high-level general audio understanding in a single codebook.
summary_en.importance: Directly relevant to the unified modeling paradigm of Audio-LLMs. Reveals a fundamental representational bottleneck of semantic speech tokenizers as Audio-LLM frontends, and proposes a dual disentanglement mechanism at both the supervision and architectural levels. A universal audio tokenizer that preserves both semantic alignment and acoustic details would simplify multi-task unified modeling in Audio-LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The UniAudio-Token framework introduces two core innovations: (1) Semantic-Acoustic Primitives (SAP): an LLM-generated structured supervision protocol that decomposes raw audio into linguistic content, vocal attributes, and auditory-scene primitives, disentangling content from style at the supervision level and forcing the model to allocate capacity for acoustic details; (2) Semantic-Acoustic Equilibrium (SAE): a content-aware gating mechanism that adaptively injects fine-grained acoustic details from shallow layers into the deep semantic stream when needed, mitigating acoustic blindness without corrupting semantic representations. The framework retains a single-codebook design for direct integration with standard LLM architectures.
summary_en.experiments: At the tokenizer level, UniAudio-Token achieves high Cluster Purity on the ESC dataset, forming distinct clusters for diverse audio events where baselines struggle. The acquisition of general audio perception does not compromise speech generation capability; it even surpasses specialized speech tokenizers in generation quality. At the Audio-LLM level, integrating this frontend with Qwen2.5 yields superior performance on both understanding and generation tasks. Ablation studies validate the adaptive behavior of the SAE mechanism.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 (Methods) for SAP's LLM-generated structured supervision and SAE gating implementation; Chapter 4 experiments for ESC cluster purity analysis and end-to-end Audio-LLM comparison. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not explicitly provided in the available content.

recommendation.zh: 做语音 LM 或统一多模态接口的人该看：它不是换个 codec，而是在单码本 semantic token 上补回 acoustic bits，值得重点看 tokenizer 设计和 ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on speech LMs or unified multimodal interfaces: the interesting part is not a new codec, but how it restores acoustic bits while keeping a single-codebook semantic interface.
